items.text: Sonam Wangchuk has expressed concerns to President Droupadi Murmu regarding administrative actions affecting critics in Ladakh. He alleges that a smear campaign is being orchestrated by the Lieutenant Governor's administration against him and others. The appeal follows the cancellation of the land lease for the Himalayan Institute of Alternatives, Ladakh, which he co-founded.

items.title: Sonia Gandhi says Penguin was 'uneasy' with criticism of govt
items.text: Sonia Gandhi expressed disappointment over Penguin Random House India's refusal to publish her memoir due to government criticism. Although inclined to publish, the publisher reportedly faced internal disagreements regarding the manuscript's content. Subsequent concerns were raised regarding potential government pressure affecting the book's publication. HarperCollins India has now confirmed publication of her memoir, 'Belonging: A Journey of Love,' on November 10.
items.summary: Sonia Gandhi said Penguin Random House India refused to publish her memoir because of criticism of the government. The publisher had internal disagreements about the content. HarperCollins India will now publish the memoir 'Belonging: A Journey of Love' on November 10.

items.text: Punjab has recorded 3,144 incidents of stubble burning between September 15 and November 6, with Tarn Taran as the highest contributor. The practice of stubble burning is often linked to increased air pollution in Delhi-NCR.

items.text: Hindustan Coca-Cola Holdings Ltd (HCCH), backed by The Coca-Cola Company and Jubilant Beverages, has filed its draft papers with the market regulator Sebi to raise funds through an initial public offering (IPO). The proposed IPO will be entirely an offer for sale (OFS) of up to 99,74,61,456 equity shares by promoter Hindustan Coca-Cola Overseas Holdings Pte Ltd, according to the draft red herring prospectus (DRHP) dated November 6. Since the issue is entirely an OFS, the company will not receive any proceeds from the IPO, with the entire proceeds going to the selling shareholder.

items.title: Priyank Kharge accuses Centre of misleading public over ethanol blending, alleges violations
items.text: Karnataka Minister Priyank Kharge claimed the Central government is misleading citizens regarding ethanol blending in petrol. He referred to laboratory reports showing blending levels exceeding announced limits, which he stated benefit certain companies. Kharge highlighted discrepancies in government statements regarding ethanol blending being an experiment only. He also addressed rising prices attributed to the government's policies impacting essential services like public transport.
items.summary: Karnataka Minister Priyank Kharge accuses the Central government of misleading the public about ethanol blending in petrol. He cites laboratory reports showing blending levels exceed announced limits, benefiting certain companies. Kharge also points to discrepancies in government statements and rising prices affecting public transport.

items.text: Mamata Banerjee alleged that the BJP disrupted a Kali Puja celebration in Kolkata's Kalighat area. She claimed that a gang attacked TMC leader Abhishek Banerjee's house during the early hours. Concerns were raised about the breakdown of law and order in West Bengal related to these incidents. CCTV footage reportedly captured assailants attacking the premises and damaging property.

items.title: Akhilesh Yadav targets BJP after part of Bismillah Khan's house demolished, Varanasi officials deny role
items.text: Samajwadi Party leader Akhilesh Yadav criticised the BJP government for the demolition of Bismillah Khan's home. He expressed concerns about the loss of cultural legacy and the integrity of Bharat Ratna awardees. Municipal officials clarified that the family chose to demolish the structure independently after declining a museum proposal. The Varanasi Municipal Corporation had earlier issued a notice concerning the building's dilapidated condition.
items.summary: Akhilesh Yadav criticised the BJP after part of Bismillah Khan's house was demolished in Varanasi. Municipal officials said the family demolished it themselves after declining a museum proposal, following a notice about the building's dilapidated condition.

items.text: The US dollar index jumped significantly following the Labor Department's report indicating an increase of 165,000 jobs last month, which far exceeded economists' forecasts. As a result, the probability of a rate hike from the Federal Reserve climbed to nearly 80% for next month. Moreover, Federal Reserve officials voiced concerns about ongoing inflation, leading to declines for other currencies such as the euro and sterling against the dollar.

items.title: Gold drops as strong US payrolls boost dollar, yields
items.text: In light of stronger-than-anticipated US payroll figures, gold prices dipped significantly as the data suggested a robust labor market. This development heightened expectations for sustained high-interest rates from the Federal Reserve, bolstering the dollar's strength. Spot gold saw a decline of 0.3% to reach $4,074.36 per ounce, while US gold futures fell by 0.9%. However, Indian retail demand picked up ahead of Diwali festivities, taking advantage of the lower prices.
items.summary: Gold prices fell after strong US payroll data strengthened the dollar and raised expectations of continued high interest rates. Spot gold declined 0.3% to $4,074.36 per ounce. Indian retail demand increased ahead of Diwali due to lower prices.

The country had banned broken rice exports on 9 September 2022 and lifted the restriction on 7 March 2025.
items.title_hi: टूटे चावल के निर्यात पर कोई नई रोक नहीं, भारत स्थिर धान खरीद पर भरोसा कर रहा
items.summary_hi: भारत टूटे चावल के निर्यात पर कोई नई रोक नहीं लगाएगा क्योंकि उसे स्थिर धान खरीद पर भरोसा है। भारत ने कैलेंडर वर्ष 2025 में 8.08 लाख टन टूटे चावल का निर्यात किया और विश्व का सबसे बड़ा चावल निर्यातक है। देश ने 9 सितंबर 2022 को टूटे चावल के निर्यात पर प्रतिबंध लगाया था और 7 मार्च 2025 को हटा दिया।

items.title: Arini’s Hedge Fund Losses Grow to 32% as It Sells Some Positions
items.text: Losses at Arini Capital Management’s main hedge fund deepened in the final days of October, taking declines to 32% for the year, according to a letter to investors seen by Bloomberg.
items.summary: Arini Capital Management's main hedge fund losses have deepened to 32% for the year. The fund sold some positions in the final days of October.
items.title_hi: Arini के हेज फंड का नुकसान 32% तक बढ़ा क्योंकि इसने कुछ पोजीशन बेचीं
items.summary_hi: Arini Capital Management के मुख्य हेज फंड का नुकसान वर्ष के लिए 32% तक गहरा गया है। फंड ने अक्टूबर के अंतिम दिनों में कुछ पोजीशन बेचीं।

items.title: 5 Killed, Several Injured In Road Accident In UP: Cops
items.text: Five persons were killed and several others sustained injuries in a fatal road accident involving a tractor-trolley in Uttar Pradesh's Sitapur district, a senior police official said here on Saturday.
items.summary: Five people were killed and several injured in a road accident involving a tractor-trolley in Sitapur district, Uttar Pradesh, on Saturday.
items.title_hi: यूपी में सड़क हादसे में 5 मरे, कई घायल: पुलिस
items.summary_hi: शनिवार को उत्तर प्रदेश के सीतापुर जिले में ट्रैक्टर-ट्रॉली की टक्कर में पांच लोगों की मौत हो गई और कई घायल हुए।

items.title: Disallowed Friday prayers, under house detention for 6th day: Mirwaiz
items.text: On the previous Friday, the Mirwaiz mentioned in his sermon the findings of the International Crisis Group report on Jammu and Kashmir and highlighted the concerns over political prisoners, civil liberties and the need for meaningful political engagement and reconciliation
items.summary: Mirwaiz was disallowed from Friday prayers and has been under house detention for the sixth day, having highlighted concerns over political prisoners and civil liberties in his previous sermon.
items.title_hi: मीरवाइज़ को जुमे की नमाज़ से रोका, छठे दिन भी हिरासत में
items.summary_hi: मीरवाइज़ को जुमे की नमाज़ की अनुमति नहीं दी गई और वे छठे दिन भी हाउस डिटेंशन में हैं, उन्होंने पिछले उपदेश में राजनीतिक कैदियों और नागरिक स्वतंत्रता पर चिंता जताई थी।

items.title: Gold Extends Drop on Stronger-Than-Expected US Employment Data
items.text: Gold fell after a hot US nonfarm payrolls print added fuel to speculations that the Federal Reserve will seek to raise interest rates to contain inflation.
items.summary: Gold prices dropped after stronger-than-expected US employment data. The data fueled speculation that the Federal Reserve may raise interest rates to combat inflation.
items.title_hi: अमेरिकी रोजगार आंकड़ों से सोने में गिरावट
items.summary_hi: मजबूत अमेरिकी रोजगार आंकड़ों के बाद सोने की कीमतें गिरीं। इससे फेडरल रिजर्व द्वारा ब्याज दरें बढ़ाने की अटकलें तेज हुईं।

items.title: CPI(M) leader Biman Basu retracts after holding Jyoti Basu responsible for LF government’s industrial policy
items.text: Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari on November 5 blamed the policy of forcible land acquisition during the regime of former Chief Minister Buddhadeb Bhattacharjee for decline in industrial prospects of the State.
items.summary: CPI(M) leader Biman Basu retracted his statement after blaming Jyoti Basu for the Left Front government's industrial policy. Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari blamed forcible land acquisition policy during Buddhadeb Bhattacharjee's regime for decline in industrial prospects.
items.title_hi: सीपीआई(एम) नेता बिमान बसु ने ज्योति बसु को एलएफ सरकार की औद्योगिक नीति का जिम्मेदार ठहराने के बाद बयान वापस लिया
items.summary_hi: सीपीआई(एम) नेता बिमान बसु ने ज्योति बसु को वाम मोर्चा सरकार की औद्योगिक नीति के लिए जिम्मेदार बताने के बाद अपना बयान वापस लिया। मुख्यमंत्री सुवेंदु अधिकारी ने बुद्धदेव भट्टाचार्य के शासन में जबरन भूमि अधिग्रहण की नीति को औद्योगिक संभावनाओं में गिरावट का कारण बताया।

items.title: West Bengal election is not legally valid: Former CEC S.Y. Quraishi
items.text: The former top poll official also reinstated that the Election Commission of India is supposed to make decisions based on a majority
items.summary: Former Chief Election Commissioner S.Y. Quraishi claims the West Bengal election is not legally valid. He also stated that the Election Commission of India should make decisions based on majority.
items.title_hi: पश्चिम बंगाल चुनाव कानूनी रूप से वैध नहीं: पूर्व CEC एस.वाई. कुरैशी
items.summary_hi: पूर्व मुख्य चुनाव आयुक्त एस.वाई. कुरैशी का दावा है कि पश्चिम बंगाल चुनाव कानूनी रूप से वैध नहीं है। उन्होंने यह भी कहा कि भारतीय चुनाव आयोग को बहुमत के आधार पर निर्णय लेने चाहिए।

items.title: Agasthyamalai conservation case: SC directs temporary and non-resident silk cotton cultivators not eligible for protection under FRA Act
items.summary: The Supreme Court directed that temporary and non-resident silk cotton cultivators are not eligible for protection under the FRA Act in the Agasthyamalai conservation case.
items.title_hi: अगस्त्यमलाई संरक्षण मामला: SC ने कहा अस्थायी और गैर-निवासी रेशम कपास कृषक FRA अधिनियम के तहत संरक्षण के पात्र नहीं
items.summary_hi: सुप्रीम कोर्ट ने अगस्त्यमलाई संरक्षण मामले में निर्देश दिया कि अस्थायी और गैर-निवासी रेशम कपास कृषक FRA अधिनियम के तहत संरक्षण के पात्र नहीं हैं।

items.title: Pakistan says willing to issue visa to Punjab CM Bhagwant Mann for visit
items.text: On October 23, Bhagwant Mann had said that he had been invited to attend the World Punjabi Conference in Lahore on November 27 questioning whether he would be allowed to travel to Pakistan
items.summary: Pakistan has said it is willing to issue a visa to Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann for a visit. Mann had earlier said he was invited to the World Punjabi Conference in Lahore on November 27.
items.title_hi: पाकिस्तान ने पंजाब CM भगवंत मान को वीजा देने की इच्छा जताई
items.summary_hi: पाकिस्तान ने कहा है कि वह पंजाब के मुख्यमंत्री भगवंत मान को वीजा देने को तैयार है। मान ने पहले कहा था कि उन्हें 27 नवंबर को लाहौर में विश्व पंजाबी सम्मेलन में आमंत्रित किया गया है।

items.title: Supreme Court decision on BBMB arrears a victory for Himachal, says CM Sukhu
items.text: The order settles a decades-old dispute over Himachal Pradesh’s 7.19% share in the power generated from the projects
items.summary: The Supreme Court has decided a long-standing dispute about Himachal Pradesh's 7.19% share in power generated from Bhakra Beas Management Board projects. Chief Minister Sukhu calls the order a victory for the state.
items.title_hi: सुप्रीम कोर्ट का BBMB बकाया पर फैसला हिमाचल के लिए जीत, CM सुक्खू ने कहा
items.summary_hi: सुप्रीम कोर्ट ने भाखड़ा ब्यास प्रबंधन बोर्ड परियोजनाओं से उत्पादित बिजली में हिमाचल प्रदेश के 7.19% हिस्से के दशकों पुराने विवाद का निपटारा किया। मुख्यमंत्री सुक्खू ने इस आदेश को राज्य की जीत बताया।

items.title: Quick Mart IPO Draws Strong Demand as Kenyan Listings Pick Up
items.text: Quick Mart Plc saw demand for shares in its initial public offering exceed the number available by almost 23% as Kenya’s second-biggest supermarket chain concluded the nation’s second IPO of the year.
items.summary: Quick Mart Plc's IPO saw demand exceed available shares by almost 23%. Kenya's second-largest supermarket chain completed the country's second IPO of the year.
items.title_hi: क्विक मार्ट आईपीओ को मजबूत मांग मिली क्योंकि केन्याई लिस्टिंग में तेजी आई
items.summary_hi: क्विक मार्ट पीएलसी के आईपीओ में मांग उपलब्ध शेयरों से लगभग 23% अधिक रही। केन्या की दूसरी सबसे बड़ी सुपरमार्केट चेन ने साल का दूसरा आईपीओ पूरा किया।

items.title: Texas’ Next Finance Chief to Ramp Up School-Vendor Scrutiny
items.text: The Democrat elected to serve as Texas’s next state comptroller vowed to increase transparency around the hundreds of millions of dollars directed to vendors in the state’s massive public school system.
items.summary: The Democrat elected as Texas's next state comptroller vowed to increase transparency around hundreds of millions of dollars directed to vendors in the public school system.
items.title_hi: टेक्सास के अगले वित्त प्रमुख स्कूल-वेंडर जांच बढ़ाएंगे
items.summary_hi: टेक्सास के नए निर्वाचित कॉम्पट्रोलर ने पब्लिक स्कूल सिस्टम में वेंडर्स को दिए जाने वाले करोड़ों डॉलर की पारदर्शिता बढ़ाने का वादा किया।

items.title: Amit Shah sets 65-seat target for BJP in Uttarakhand, calls for third consecutive term
items.text: Union Home Minister Amit Shah has set a target of more than 65 seats for the BJP in Uttarakhand's 70-member Assembly, urging party workers to secure a third consecutive term. At a rally marking the state's 26th Foundation Day, he also targeted Congress over alleged encroachments and Rahul Gandhi's 'Vote Bachao Yatra'.
items.summary: Union Home Minister Amit Shah set a target of more than 65 seats for BJP in Uttarakhand's 70-member Assembly, urging a third consecutive term and targeting Congress over alleged encroachments and Rahul Gandhi's 'Vote Bachao Yatra'.
items.title_hi: अमित शाह ने उत्तराखंड में भाजपा के लिए 65+ सीटों का लक्ष्य रखा
items.summary_hi: गृह मंत्री अमित शाह ने उत्तराखंड की 70 सीटों वाली विधानसभा में भाजपा के लिए 65 से अधिक सीटों का लक्ष्य रखा, तीसरे कार्यकाल का आह्वान किया और कांग्रेस पर आरोप लगाए।

items.title: Biryani By Kilo, D-Mart Face Action In Maharashtra Crackdown Ahead Of Diwali
items.text: The drive covered several big quick-commerce platforms and popular food chains. In Mumbai, the licences of Zepto (Worli) and Blinkit (Blink Commerce Pvt Ltd) were suspended. Eateries including Biryani By Kilo, Tossin Pizza (Worli) and Jumbo Burger also faced the same action.
items.summary: Maharashtra authorities cracked down on quick-commerce platforms and food chains ahead of Diwali. Licences of Zepto (Worli) and Blinkit were suspended in Mumbai. Biryani By Kilo, Tossin Pizza (Worli) and Jumbo Burger also faced licence suspension.
items.title_hi: बिरयानी बाय किलो, डी-मार्ट पर दीवाली से पहले महाराष्ट्र की कार्रवाई
items.summary_hi: महाराष्ट्र अधिकारियों ने दीवाली से पहले क्विक-कॉमर्स प्लेटफॉर्म और फूड चेन पर कार्रवाई की। मुंबई में जेप्टो (वरली) और ब्लिंकिट के लाइसेंस निलंबित किए गए। बिरयानी बाय किलो, टॉसिन पिज्जा (वरली) और जंबो बर्गर के लाइसेंस भी निलंबित हुए।

items.title: Ajit Pawar had planned NCP merger by February 12, Sunil Tatkare says
items.text: NCP Maharashtra president Sunil Tatkare has said Ajit Pawar had finalised a blueprint to reunite the two NCP factions by February 12, but the plan stalled after his death on January 28. His remarks have revived merger speculation following Praful Patel's meeting with Sharad Pawar in Mumbai.
items.summary: NCP Maharashtra president Sunil Tatkare said Ajit Pawar had planned to merge the two NCP factions by February 12. The plan stalled after Ajit Pawar's death on January 28. Merger speculation revived after Praful Patel met Sharad Pawar in Mumbai.
items.title_hi: अजित पवार ने 12 फरवरी तक एनसीपी विलय की योजना बनाई थी, सुनील तटकरे ने कहा
items.summary_hi: एनसीपी महाराष्ट्र अध्यक्ष सुनील तटकरे ने कहा कि अजित पवार ने दोनों एनसीपी गुटों को 12 फरवरी तक मिलाने की योजना बनाई थी। उनकी मृत्यु 28 जनवरी को होने के बाद योजना रुक गई। प्रफुल्ल पटेल की शरद पवार से मुंबई में मुलाकात के बाद विलय की अटकलें फिर शुरू हुईं।

items.title: Analysis: From Hospital Bed, Sharad Pawar Keeps Maharashtra Guessing Over NCP-NDA Move
items.text: For the last six decades, Sharad Pawar has been one of the most unpredictable leaders in Maharashtra's, or even India's, politics.
items.summary: Sharad Pawar, from his hospital bed, continues to keep Maharashtra uncertain about a potential NCP-NDA alliance. He has been an unpredictable leader in Maharashtra and Indian politics for six decades.
items.title_hi: विश्लेषण: अस्पताल के बिस्तर से, शरद पवार महाराष्ट्र को NCP-NDA गठबंधन पर असमंजस में रखे हुए हैं
items.summary_hi: शरद पवार अपने अस्पताल के बिस्तर से महाराष्ट्र को NCP-NDA गठबंधन के बारे में अनिश्चित रखे हुए हैं। वे पिछले छह दशकों से महाराष्ट्र और भारत की राजनीति में सबसे अप्रत्याशित नेताओं में से एक रहे हैं।

items.title: Farooq Abdullah dismisses NC rift reports as ‘baseless rumours’ after meeting with dissident MLAs
items.text: National Conference president Farooq Abdullah has rejected reports of a split in the ruling party after meeting Chief Minister Omar Abdullah and MLAs who had raised concerns over its functioning. He said the leadership had heard their grievances and would take steps to strengthen the party and the government.
items.summary: Farooq Abdullah dismissed reports of a split in the National Conference as baseless rumours after meeting with dissident MLAs and Chief Minister Omar Abdullah. He said the leadership heard their grievances and will take steps to strengthen the party and government.
items.title_hi: फारूक अब्दुल्ला ने NC में दरार की खबरों को 'निराधार अफवाहें' बताया, असंतुष्ट MLAs से मुलाकात के बाद
items.summary_hi: फारूक अब्दुल्ला ने नेशनल कॉन्फ्रेंस में फूट की खबरों को निराधार अफवाहें बताकर खारिज कर दिया, असंतुष्ट MLAs और मुख्यमंत्री उमर अब्दुल्ला से मुलाकात के बाद। उन्होंने कहा कि नेतृत्व ने उनकी शिकायतें सुनी हैं और पार्टी व सरकार को मजबूत करने के लिए कदम उठाएगा।

items.title: Delhi College Accountant Duped Of Rs 80 Lakh In 'Boss Fraud'
items.text: The incident happened in Delhi's Chanderprabhu Jain College of Higher Studies and School of Law located in Narela, run by Rishi Aurobindo Educational Society.
items.summary: An accountant at a Delhi college was duped of Rs 80 lakh in a 'boss fraud' incident. The incident occurred at Chanderprabhu Jain College of Higher Studies and School of Law in Narela, run by Rishi Aurobindo Educational Society.
items.title_hi: दिल्ली कॉलेज के अकाउंटेंट से 'बॉस फ्रॉड' में 80 लाख रुपये की ठगी
items.summary_hi: दिल्ली के एक कॉलेज के अकाउंटेंट से 'बॉस फ्रॉड' में 80 लाख रुपये की ठगी हुई। यह घटना नरेला स्थित चंदरप्रभु जैन कॉलेज ऑफ हायर स्टडीज एंड स्कूल ऑफ लॉ में हुई, जिसे ऋषि अरबिंदो एजुकेशनल सोसायटी चलाती है।

items.title: SC issues contempt notice to Kerala Congress leaders over post seeking CJI Surya Kant's resignation
items.text: The Supreme Court has issued a show-cause contempt notice to Kerala Pradesh Congress Committee office-bearers over an October 12 social media post demanding Chief Justice Surya Kant's resignation. The bench said freedom of expression cannot be used to interfere with the administration of justice and warned against attempts to undermine judicial authority.
items.summary: The Supreme Court has issued a contempt notice to Kerala Congress leaders over a social media post demanding the Chief Justice's resignation. The court said freedom of expression cannot be used to interfere with the administration of justice.
items.title_hi: सुप्रीम कोर्ट ने केरल कांग्रेस नेताओं को CJI सूर्य कांत के इस्तीफे की मांग वाली पोस्ट पर अवमानना नोटिस जारी किया
items.summary_hi: सुप्रीम कोर्ट ने केरल कांग्रेस नेताओं को एक सोशल मीडिया पोस्ट के लिए अवमानना नोटिस दिया है जिसमें CJI के इस्तीफे की मांग की गई थी। कोर्ट ने कहा कि अभिव्यक्ति की आजादी का इस्तेमाल न्याय प्रशासन में दखल के लिए नहीं किया जा सकता।

items.title: EC gives voters left out of SIR draft rolls ‘one more opportunity’ to re-enrol; restores old EPIC numbers
items.text: The Election Commission has offered voters excluded from draft electoral rolls in seven states a fresh opportunity to re-enrol after being marked Absent, Shifted, Dead or Duplicate. Eligible applicants will have their original EPIC numbers restored in final rolls, while election officials have been directed to undertake door-to-door outreach.
items.summary: The Election Commission has given voters excluded from draft electoral rolls in seven states another chance to re-enrol. Their original EPIC numbers will be restored in the final rolls, and officials will conduct door-to-door outreach.
items.title_hi: चुनाव आयोग ने SIR ड्राफ्ट रोल से बाहर मतदाताओं को फिर से नामांकन का मौका दिया
items.summary_hi: चुनाव आयोग ने सात राज्यों में ड्राफ्ट मतदाता सूची से बाहर किए गए मतदाताओं को फिर से नामांकन का एक और मौका दिया है। उनके मूल EPIC नंबर अंतिम सूची में बहाल किए जाएंगे और अधिकारी घर-घर जाकर संपर्क करेंगे।

items.title: Samvat 2082: Commodities witness sharp volatility as crude surges
items.text: Brent crude surged 60.4% in Samvat 2082 amid the US-Iran conflict, while gold and silver fell in dollar terms after retreating from record highs, though rupee depreciation supported domestic returns.
items.summary: Commodities saw sharp volatility in Samvat 2082 with Brent crude surging 60.4% amid US-Iran conflict. Gold and silver fell in dollar terms after retreating from record highs, though rupee depreciation supported domestic returns.
items.title_hi: संवत 2082: कमोडिटीज में तेज अस्थिरता देखी गई क्योंकि कच्चा तेल बढ़ा
items.summary_hi: संवत 2082 में कमोडिटीज में तेज अस्थिरता देखी गई जहां Brent crude US-ईरान संघर्ष के बीच 60.4% बढ़ा। सोना और चांदी डॉलर के संदर्भ में रिकॉर्ड ऊंचाई से पीछे हटने के बाद गिरे, हालांकि रुपये के अवमूल्यन ने घरेलू रिटर्न का समर्थन किया।

items.title: Best-ever Samvat for IPOs: Record ₹2.23 trillion raised, up 19.6%
items.text: India's primary market raised a record ₹2.23 trillion through 375 IPOs in Samvat 2082, with mainboard issues accounting for ₹2.12 trillion and SME offerings for the rest.
items.summary: India's primary market raised a record ₹2.23 trillion through 375 IPOs in Samvat 2082, up 19.6%. Mainboard issues accounted for ₹2.12 trillion, with the rest from SME offerings.
items.title_hi: आईपीओ के लिए सर्वश्रेष्ठ संवत: रिकॉर्ड ₹2.23 ट्रिलियन जुटाए, 19.6% वृद्धि
items.summary_hi: भारत के प्राथमिक बाजार ने संवत 2082 में 375 आईपीओ के जरिए रिकॉर्ड ₹2.23 ट्रिलियन जुटाए, जो 19.6% अधिक है। मेनबोर्ड इश्यू ₹2.12 ट्रिलियन के रहे, बाकी SME से।

items.title: Rahul Gandhi calls SIR a ‘conspiracy’, alleges voter deletions could deny people welfare benefits
items.text: Rahul Gandhi has accused the BJP-led Centre of using the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls to deprive people opposed to the ruling party of voting rights and access to welfare schemes. His criticism followed Union minister Lalan Singh's remarks on identifying scheme beneficiaries through voter ID details.
items.summary: Rahul Gandhi has called the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls a conspiracy by the BJP-led Centre. He alleges it could delete voters opposed to the ruling party and deny them welfare benefits. This follows Union Minister Lalan Singh's remarks on using voter ID details to identify scheme beneficiaries.
items.title_hi: राहुल गांधी ने SIR को 'षड्यंत्र' बताया, मतदाता हटाने से कल्याण योजनाओं से वंचित होने का आरोप
items.summary_hi: राहुल गांधी ने विशेष गहन पुनरीक्षण (SIR) को भाजपा नीत केंद्र की साजिश बताया। आरोप है कि इससे सत्ताधारी दल का विरोध करने वालों के मताधिकार और कल्याण योजनाओं तक पहुंच छीनी जा सकती है। यह केंद्रीय मंत्री ललन सिंह के मतदाता पहचान पत्र से लाभार्थियों की पहचान वाले बयान के बाद आया।

items.title: Man Confronts Tour Operators About Missing Parents. They Beat Him To Death
items.text: According to a police complaint, the victim, Haider Ansari, grew anxious after his parents, who went to Saudi Arabia on October 7 for Umrah, failed to come home days after their scheduled return date of October 24.
items.summary: A man named Haider Ansari was beaten to death after confronting tour operators about his missing parents. His parents had gone to Saudi Arabia for Umrah and did not return on the scheduled date.
items.title_hi: टूर ऑपरेटर्स से लापता माता-पिता के बारे में पूछने पर व्यक्ति को पीट-पीटकर मार डाला
items.summary_hi: हैदर अंसारी नाम के व्यक्ति को टूर ऑपरेटर्स ने पीट-पीटकर मार डाला जब उसने अपने लापता माता-पिता के बारे में पूछा। उसके माता-पिता उमराह के लिए सऊदी अरब गए थे और तय तारीख पर नहीं लौटे।

items.title: Weakest Samvat in 15 years ends on a high for mkts as Sensex, Nifty rally
items.text: The Sensex and Nifty ended Samvat 2082 with losses of 4% and 3.1%, respectively, despite a sharp late rally that delivered their biggest weekly gains in nearly six years.
items.summary: The Sensex and Nifty ended Samvat 2082 with losses of 4% and 3.1% respectively. A late rally gave them their biggest weekly gains in nearly six years.
items.title_hi: 15 साल में सबसे कमजोर Samvat 2082 Sensex, Nifty की रैली के साथ ऊंचे स्तर पर समाप्त
items.summary_hi: Sensex और Nifty ने Samvat 2082 को क्रमशः 4% और 3.1% के नुकसान के साथ समाप्त किया। एक देर से रैली ने उन्हें लगभग छह वर्षों में सबसे बड़ा साप्ताहिक लाभ दिया।

items.title: Street basks in Diwali glow: Benchmark indices post best week in 6 years
items.text: Rupee shines across Asia; Brent sinks most in a week since Covid
items.summary: Benchmark indices posted their best week in six years. The rupee strengthened across Asia while Brent crude fell the most in a week since Covid.
items.title_hi: दिवाली की चमक में बाजार: बेंचमार्क सूचकांकों ने 6 साल में सबसे अच्छा सप्ताह दर्ज किया
items.summary_hi: बेंचमार्क सूचकांकों ने छह वर्षों में अपना सर्वश्रेष्ठ सप्ताह दर्ज किया। रुपया पूरे एशिया में मजबूत हुआ, जबकि ब्रेंट कच्चा तेल कोविड के बाद से एक सप्ताह में सबसे ज्यादा गिरा।

items.title: Oil Companies Reject Karnataka Minister's '30% Ethanol' Charge Over E20 Petrol, Question Testing Method
items.text: Indian Oil, Bharat Petroleum, and Hindustan Petroleum said the claims, as reported, were "not supported by testing conducted in accordance with the prescribed statutory and technical procedures".
items.summary: Indian Oil, Bharat Petroleum, and Hindustan Petroleum have rejected a Karnataka minister's claim about 30% ethanol in E20 petrol. The companies said the claim is not supported by testing done under prescribed procedures.
items.title_hi: तेल कंपनियों ने कर्नाटक मंत्री के E20 पेट्रोल में '30% इथेनॉल' के आरोप को खारिज किया
items.summary_hi: इंडियन ऑयल, भारत पेट्रोलियम और हिंदुस्तान पेट्रोलियम ने कर्नाटक के मंत्री के E20 पेट्रोल में 30% इथेनॉल होने के दावे को खारिज कर दिया। कंपनियों ने कहा कि यह दावा निर्धारित प्रक्रियाओं के तहत की गई जांच द्वारा समर्थित नहीं है।

items.title: Gold, silver turn volatile after strong US jobs data, but remain on track to snap multi-week losing streaks
items.text: Gold and silver prices fell on Friday as stronger-than-expected US jobs data lifted expectations of a Federal Reserve rate hike in December. Gold was down ₹1,700 to ₹1,42,930 per 10 grams, while silver slipped 1.26% to ₹1,84,800 per kilogram.
items.summary: Gold fell ₹1,700 to ₹1,42,930 per 10 grams, and silver slipped 1.26% to ₹1,84,800 per kg after strong US jobs data raised expectations of a Fed rate hike in December.
items.title_hi: मजबूत अमेरिकी नौकरियों के आंकड़ों के बाद सोना, चांदी अस्थिर हुए, लेकिन बहु-सप्ताह की गिरावट की लकीर को तोड़ने की राह पर
items.summary_hi: मजबूत अमेरिकी नौकरियों के आंकड़ों ने दिसंबर में फेडरल रिजर्व द्वारा दर वृद्धि की उम्मीदें बढ़ा दीं, जिससे सोना ₹1,700 गिरकर ₹1,42,930 प्रति 10 ग्राम पर आ गया, जबकि चांदी 1.26% फिसलकर ₹1,84,800 प्रति किलोग्राम पर आ गई।

items.title: Supreme Court Orders SIT Probe Into Illegal Gravel Mining In Rajasthan's Luni, Jojari And Bandi Rivers, Bars New Industries Near River Ecosystem
items.summary: The Supreme Court has ordered an SIT probe into illegal gravel mining in Rajasthan's Luni, Jojari and Bandi rivers. It has also barred new industries near the river ecosystem.

items.summary_hi: सुप्रीम कोर्ट ने राजस्थान की लूनी, जोजरी और बांडी नदियों में अवैध बजरी खनन की SIT जांच का आदेश दिया है। इसने नदी पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र के पास नए उद्योगों पर भी रोक लगा दी है।

items.title: Dhanteras special: Gold beats stocks or Nifty takes the lead? Gold vs Nifty 50 returns in Samvat 2082 compared
items.text: Indian equities endured volatility in Samvat 2082 amid geopolitical tensions, oil-price swings and inflation concerns. A late rally lifted the Nifty 50 more than 10% in seven sessions, but the index is still set to finish the year down about 3.24%.
items.summary: Indian equities were volatile in Samvat 2082 due to geopolitical tensions, oil-price swings and inflation concerns. A late rally lifted the Nifty 50 over 10% in seven sessions, but the index is still set to finish the year down about 3.24%.
items.title_hi: धनतेरस विशेष: सोना बनाम Nifty 50 रिटर्न Samvat 2082 में तुलना
items.summary_hi: भारतीय इक्विटी Samvat 2082 में भू-राजनीतिक तनाव, तेल की कीमतों में उतार-चढ़ाव और मुद्रास्फीति की चिंताओं के कारण अस्थिर रहीं। एक देर से रैली ने Nifty 50 को सात सत्रों में 10% से अधिक बढ़ा दिया, लेकिन सूचकांक अभी भी वर्ष को लगभग 3.24% की गिरावट के साथ समाप्त करने के लिए तैयार है।

items.title: Bank locker risks: How to protect your valuables and avoid financial losses
items.text: A consumer commission ruling against Union Bank highlights how customers can protect locker valuables through proper documentation, surrender acknowledgements, insurance and timely complaints.
items.summary: A consumer commission ruling against Union Bank highlights risks with bank lockers. Customers can protect valuables through proper documentation, surrender acknowledgements, insurance, and timely complaints to avoid financial losses.
items.title_hi: बैंक लॉकर के जोखिम: कीमती सामान की सुरक्षा और वित्तीय नुकसान से बचाव
items.summary_hi: उपभोक्ता आयोग का यूनियन बैंक के खिलाफ फैसला लॉकर जोखिमों को उजागर करता है। ग्राहक उचित दस्तावेज, सरेंडर पावती, बीमा और समय पर शिकायत से कीमती सामान की रक्षा कर सकते हैं।

items.title: Rupee strengthens to close at a six-and-a-half-month high
items.text: The Indian currency closed at 93.90 per USD, up 57 paise against the previous close of 94.47
items.summary: The rupee strengthened to close at a six-and-a-half-month high. It closed at 93.90 per USD, up 57 paise from the previous close of 94.47.
items.title_hi: रुपया साढ़े छह महीने के उच्च स्तर पर बंद होकर मजबूत हुआ
items.summary_hi: रुपया साढ़े छह महीने के उच्च स्तर पर बंद होकर मजबूत हुआ। यह 93.90 प्रति USD पर बंद हुआ, जो पिछले बंद 94.47 से 57 पैसे ऊपर है।

items.title: Karnataka flags ethanol levels crossing the permissible 20% limit in petrol samples
items.text: Tests detect ethanol levels up to 31.2 per cent, raising mileage concerns

items.title_hi: कर्नाटक ने पेट्रोल नमूनों में 20% की अनुमेय सीमा से अधिक इथेनॉल स्तर पाया

items.title: Nifty reclaims 25,000, Sensex crosses 81,000 as India shrugs off global tech rout
items.text: The Sensex surged 1,718 points or 2.17% to close at 81,028, while the Nifty gained 493.75 points or 2.01% to settle at 25,030, reclaiming the 25,000 mark for the first time in over eight months
items.summary: The Sensex rose 1,718 points (2.17%) to close at 81,028, and the Nifty gained 493.75 points (2.01%) to settle at 25,030, reclaiming the 25,000 level for the first time in over eight months.
items.title_hi: Nifty ने 25,000 को पुनः प्राप्त किया, Sensex ने 81,000 को पार किया क्योंकि भारत ने वैश्विक तकनीकी मंदी को नजरअंदाज किया
items.summary_hi: Sensex 1,718 अंक (2.17%) बढ़कर 81,028 पर बंद हुआ, जबकि Nifty 493.75 अंक (2.01%) बढ़कर 25,030 पर बंद हुआ, आठ महीनों में पहली बार 25,000 के स्तर को पुनः प्राप्त किया।

items.title: Supreme Court Dismisses Plea Challenging Allahabad HC's Senior Designations Conferred In 2019

items.title_hi: मानकसिया कोटेड मेटल्स ने QIP के जरिए ₹150 करोड़ जुटाए

items.title: Nvidia shares rebound over 7% after biggest single-day crash in nearly 2 years; what led to the sentiment reversal?
items.text: Nvidia shares rebounded 7.3% Friday after plunging 9.3% in the previous session, as investors weighed political risks to data centre expansion. The stock remains 25% below its peak amid concerns about AI investment costs, regulation and whether massive spending will generate sufficient returns.
items.summary: Nvidia shares rebounded 7.3% after a 9.3% plunge in the previous session. Investors weighed political risks to data centre expansion. The stock remains 25% below its peak amid concerns about AI investment costs and regulation.
items.title_hi: Nvidia के शेयरों में लगभग 2 साल की सबसे बड़ी एकदिवसीय गिरावट के बाद 7% से अधिक की वापसी; भावना परिवर्तन का क्या कारण रहा?

items.title: Gland Pharma Q2FY27 results: Net profit rises 58% to ₹290.75 crore
items.text: Gland Pharma on Friday posted a 58.29 per cent rise in consolidated net profit to Rs 290.75 crore in the September quarter, driven by strong execution across businesses. The company had reported a net profit of Rs 183.68 crore in the year-ago period. The pharmaceutical company's revenue from operations rose to Rs 1,833.58 crore in the quarter under review from Rs 1,486.87 crore a year ago, the company said in a regulatory filing. Total expenses also rose to Rs 1,471.69 crore in the July-September period from Rs 1,287.12 crore a year earlier, it said. The company launched four molecules -- Suga
items.summary: Gland Pharma posted a 58% rise in consolidated net profit to ₹290.75 crore for the September quarter. Revenue from operations increased to ₹1,833.58 crore from ₹1,486.87 crore a year earlier.

items.text: India's forex reserves dropped by USD 2.691 billion to USD 717.056 billion during the week ended October 30, the RBI said on Friday. In the previous week, the forex kitty had reduced by USD 1.269 billion to USD 719.748 billion. The reserves had touched an all-time high of USD 785.706 billion during the week ended September 4, driven by a heavy flow of currency as part of a special concessional swap for deposits from the diaspora through which banks raised a record USD 133 billion, but have been on a decline ever since. Experts attribute this decline to the deployment of the FCNR(B) resources a
items.summary: India's foreign exchange reserves fell by USD 2.691 billion to USD 717.056 billion in the week ended October 30. The previous week saw a decline of USD 1.269 billion. Reserves had peaked at USD 785.706 billion in early September before declining.

items.title: Copper falls for 4th day, heads for worst week since March on AI rout
items.text: Copper prices have faced yet another decline, marking four consecutive sessions of decrease, primarily due to a dip in technology shares and rising concerns over artificial intelligence investments. The three-month copper rate on the London Metal Exchange fell to a low not seen since late July. While tight supply, particularly outside the US, has cushioned further losses, a significant drop in copper stocks within Chinese warehouses is intensifying supply anxieties.

items.text: Siemens Limited announced a consolidated net profit of Rs 504 crore for the quarter ending September 30, 2026. items.text: The Indian rupee strengthened past 94 per dollar after regaining appeal among emerging-market currencies recently. Significant foreign inflows into Indian equities and a sharp fall in oil prices are key factors. Analysts suggest India's equity markets may attract global investments as concerns about AI infrastructure spending grow. The Reserve Bank of India announced measures to support the rupee against maintaining fluctuations.

items.title: Supreme Court agrees to hear DMK leader's plea challenging rejection of election petition
items.text: The Supreme Court agreed to hear a plea by DMK leader K R Periyakaruppan regarding the election results. Periyakaruppan is contesting TVK candidate R Seenivasa Sethupathi's victory by one vote in Tamil Nadu Assembly elections. The Madras High Court had previously rejected Periyakaruppan's election petition challenging the results declared on May 4. The plea argues that a significant number of postal ballots were rejected, affecting the results.
items.summary: The Supreme Court agreed to hear DMK leader K R Periyakaruppan's plea challenging the election result. He is contesting TVK candidate R Seenivasa Sethupathi's victory by one vote in the Tamil Nadu Assembly elections. The Madras High Court had earlier rejected his election petition.

items.title: DGTR recommends imposition of quantitative restrictions on soda ash imports for 2 years
items.text: The Directorate General of Trade Remedies has signaled its intention to introduce protective measures to curb the influx of soda ash imports. This action responds to an appeal from the Alkali Manufacturers Association of India due to a troubling spike in imports. The proposed two-year quantitative restrictions will allocate specific quotas per country, distributing these annual restrictions in quarterly segments to ensure domestic manufacturers are protected.
items.summary: The Directorate General of Trade Remedies recommends quantitative restrictions on soda ash imports for two years. The move follows a request from the Alkali Manufacturers Association of India due to a spike in imports. Quotas will be allocated per country and distributed quarterly.

items.title: SC issues notice to all office bearers of Keralam unit of Cong over post targeting CJI Surya Kant
items.text: In a striking move, the Supreme Court has sent a contempt notice to Kerala's Congress party over a slanderous post aimed at the Chief Justice. The post quickly went viral, prompting fierce criticism leading to its removal by the party. KPCC president Sunny Joseph affirmed that the offending member was terminated and asserted that such behavior does not align with the party’s values.
items.summary: The Supreme Court sent a contempt notice to office bearers of Kerala's Congress unit over a post targeting CJI Surya Kant. The post went viral and was later removed. The KPCC president said the offending member was terminated.
items.title_hi: SC ने CJI सूर्यकांत को निशाना बनाने वाली पोस्ट पर कांग्रेस की केरलम इकाई के पदाधिकारियों को नोटिस जारी किया
items.summary_hi: सुप्रीम कोर्ट ने CJI सूर्यकांत को निशाना बनाने वाली मानहानिकारक पोस्ट पर केरल कांग्रेस इकाई के पदाधिकारियों को अवमानना नोटिस भेजा। पोस्ट वायरल हुई और फिर हटा दी गई। KPCC अध्यक्ष ने कहा कि दोषी सदस्य को बर्खास्त कर दिया गया है।

items.title: Aga Syed Ruhullah Mehdi resigns from Lok Sabha and National Conference amid party disagreements
items.text: Aga Syed Ruhullah Mehdi, the MP from Srinagar, recently resigned from his position in Lok Sabha and the National Conference. His resignation was accepted, effective November 3, 2026, amid rising tensions with party leadership. Mehdi publicly criticised Chief Minister Omar Abdullah and NC president Farooq Abdullah during a memorial event for his father. items.summary: US stocks suffered their worst rout since 2020. The Nasdaq fell 6.4% and the Dow dropped 1,833 points. Investors fled to safer assets on worries about AI valuations and possible policy shifts.
items.title_hi: 2020 के बाद सबसे बुरा US स्टॉक रूट: नैस्डैक 6.4% गिरा, डाउ 1,833 पॉइंट लुढ़का
items.summary_hi: US शेयरों में 2020 के बाद सबसे बड़ी गिरावट आई। नैस्डैक 6.4% और डाउ 1,833 पॉइंट गिरा। निवेशक AI वैल्यूएशन और पॉलिसी बदलाव की चिंता में सुरक्षित एसेट की ओर भागे।

items.title: Wall Street fear gauge soars as retail traders bolt amid market rout
items.text: Investors rushed to protect portfolios against further losses as volatility surged, systematic funds prepared large sales and confidence in technology stocks weakened
items.summary: Wall Street's fear gauge surged as retail traders exited positions. Volatility jumped and systematic funds prepared large sales. Confidence in technology stocks weakened further.

items.text: The accident occurred near the Jone-Ludru turn, before Poda, on the Karra-Torpa main road within the Karra police station area. Among the victims were four women and three children.

items.title: Maharashtra govt approves one-year age relaxation for recruitment exams, panel proposes over 16,000 MPSC Group C vacancies
items.text: According to the report, around 12 lakh candidates have applied for the MPSC Group C Combined Preliminary Examination 2026, for which more than 5,000 vacancies have been advertised

items.title_hi: महाराष्ट्र सरकार ने भर्ती परीक्षाओं के लिए एक वर्ष की आयु छूट मंजूर की, पैनल ने 16,000 से अधिक MPSC ग्रुप C पदों का प्रस्ताव दिया
items.summary_hi: महाराष्ट्र सरकार ने भर्ती परीक्षाओं के लिए एक वर्ष की आयु छूट मंजूर की। एक पैनल ने 16,000 से अधिक MPSC ग्रुप C पदों का प्रस्ताव दिया। MPSC ग्रुप C संयुक्त प्रारंभिक परीक्षा 2026 के लिए लगभग 12 लाख उम्मीदवारों ने आवेदन किया है, जिसके लिए 5,000 से अधिक पद विज्ञापित हैं।

items.title: Festive season crackdown: Maharashtra FDA seizes food stock worth ₹63.45 crore
items.text: According to a press note issued by the FDA, officials inspected 9,667 food establishments across Maharashtra, issued 4,603 improvement notices and initiated action to cancel 25 licences and registrations
items.summary: Maharashtra FDA seized food stock worth ₹63.45 crore during a festive season crackdown. Officials inspected 9,667 food establishments, issued 4,603 improvement notices, and initiated action to cancel 25 licences and registrations.
items.title_hi: त्योहारी मौसम में कार्रवाई: महाराष्ट्र FDA ने ₹63.45 करोड़ का खाद्य स्टॉक जब्त किया
items.summary_hi: महाराष्ट्र FDA ने त्योहारी मौसम में कार्रवाई के दौरान ₹63.45 करोड़ का खाद्य स्टॉक जब्त किया। अधिकारियों ने महाराष्ट्र में 9,667 खाद्य प्रतिष्ठानों का निरीक्षण किया, 4,603 सुधार नोटिस जारी किए और 25 लाइसेंस और पंजीकरण रद्द करने की कार्रवाई शुरू की।

items.title: Maharashtra FDA seizes drugs, cosmetics worth ₹34.51 lakh, cancels 122 licences
items.text: The FDA urged citizens to report instances of illegal drug manufacturing or sales, as well as suspected substandard drugs, medical devices and cosmetics, to its commissioner’s office or the nearest district office
items.summary: Maharashtra FDA seized drugs and cosmetics worth ₹34.51 lakh and cancelled 122 licences. The FDA urged citizens to report illegal drug manufacturing, sales, and substandard medical products to its commissioner's office or nearest district office.
items.title_hi: महाराष्ट्र FDA ने ₹34.51 लाख की दवाएं, कॉस्मेटिक्स जब्त कीं, 122 लाइसेंस रद्द किए
items.summary_hi: महाराष्ट्र FDA ने ₹34.51 लाख की दवाएं और कॉस्मेटिक्स जब्त किए और 122 लाइसेंस रद्द किए। FDA ने नागरिकों से अवैध दवा निर्माण, बिक्री और घटिया चिकित्सा उत्पादों की शिकायत कमिश्नर कार्यालय या निकटतम जिला कार्यालय में करने को कहा।

items.title: Jailed Millennial Banker’s Unicorn Dream Topples Paraguay Leader
items.text: Miguel Vázquez, a millennial triathlete who owned one of Paraguay’s largest banks, dreamed of creating his country’s first unicorn and being the first to list a local company on the New York Stock Exchange.
items.summary: A jailed millennial banker who owned one of Paraguay's largest banks had dreamed of creating the country's first unicorn and listing a local company on the New York Stock Exchange. His ambitions have reportedly toppled Paraguay's leader.

items.text: With BJP intensifying its anti-drug campaign against the Punjab government and speculation growing over a possible SAD-BJP reunion, AAP seeks to shift the spotlight to the alleged Akali drug-money network and put the Centre on the spot.

items.title: JP Morgan to add Philippines and Saudi Arabia to key EM bond index over 10 months
items.text: JP Morgan has announced plans to include Saudi Arabia and the Philippines in its emerging market debt index starting in 2027. The Saudi riyal-denominated sukuk and Philippine peso-denominated government bonds will be integrated over a ten-month period. The index is expected to adjust the maximum country weight limit from 10% to 9%. Saudi Arabia's weight will reach 2.71%, while the Philippines will have a weight of 1.64%.
items.summary: JP Morgan will add Saudi Arabia and the Philippines to its emerging market bond index starting in 2027. The inclusion will happen over ten months. The index will also lower the maximum country weight from 10% to 9%.
items.title_hi: JP Morgan EM बॉन्ड इंडेक्स में फिलीपींस और सऊदी अरब जुड़ेंगे 10 महीने में
items.summary_hi: JP Morgan 2027 से सऊदी अरब और फिलीपींस को अपने उभरते बाजार बॉन्ड इंडेक्स में शामिल करेगा। यह 10 महीने में होगा। इंडेक्स अधिकतम देश वेट 10% से घटाकर 9% करेगा।

items.title: The average US 30-year mortgage rate falls to 7.18% this week, its third straight decline
items.text: The average long-term mortgage rates in the U.S. decreased for the third consecutive week, offering some respite. The average 30-year fixed-rate mortgage declined to 7.18% from 7.24%, according to Freddie Mac. Additionally, the 15-year fixed-rate mortgages saw a drop to 6.57%, slightly down from last week. These lower rates help to alleviate the financial burden on prospective homebuyers facing increased costs.
items.summary: The average US 30-year fixed mortgage rate fell to 7.18% this week, marking the third consecutive weekly decline. The 15-year fixed rate also dropped slightly to 6.57%. These lower rates provide some relief to homebuyers facing high costs.
items.title_hi: अमेरिका में 30-वर्षीय बंधक दर गिरकर 7.18% हुई, लगातार तीसरी साप्ताहिक गिरावट
items.summary_hi: अमेरिका में औसत 30-वर्षीय निश्चित बंधक दर इस सप्ताह गिरकर 7.18% हो गई, जो लगातार तीसरी साप्ताहिक गिरावट है। 15-वर्षीय निश्चित दर भी थोड़ी गिरकर 6.57% पर आ गई। इन कम दरों से ऊंची लागत का सामना कर रहे घर खरीदारों को कुछ राहत मिली है।

items.title: Karnataka to probe electoral fraud, Form 7 misuse: Shivakumar
items.text: Karnataka Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar announced a police investigation into alleged electoral fraud by the BJP. He accused the party of manipulating voter rolls and distributing pre-filled Form 7 applications. Shivakumar highlighted the removal of many voters, especially from marginalized communities, during recent electoral processes. He emphasized the importance of protecting voting rights and restoring names to electoral rolls.
items.summary: Karnataka Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar announced a police investigation into alleged electoral fraud by the BJP. He accused the party of manipulating voter rolls and distributing pre-filled Form 7 applications, leading to removal of many voters from marginalized communities.
items.title_hi: कर्नाटक करेगा चुनावी धोखाधड़ी और फॉर्म 7 के दुरुपयोग की जांच: शिवकुमार
items.summary_hi: कर्नाटक के मुख्यमंत्री डी.के. शिवकुमार ने भाजपा द्वारा कथित चुनावी धोखाधड़ी की पुलिस जांच की घोषणा की। उन्होंने पार्टी पर मतदाता सूची में हेरफेर करने और पहले से भरे फॉर्म 7 आवेदन वितरित करने का आरोप लगाया, जिससे हाशिए के समुदायों के कई मतदाताओं के नाम हटा दिए गए।

items.title: US yields fall in choppy session as oil rises and equities sink
items.text: As geopolitical tensions change the landscape, US Treasuries are witnessing a spike in demand while equity markets take a hit and oil prices show volatility. Investors are reassessing their outlook on the US-Iran relations following new election results. The labor market remains resilient with dropping unemployment claims and heightened productivity levels, pointing towards ongoing inflation risk.
items.summary: US Treasury yields fell in a volatile session as oil prices rose and equity markets declined. Investors are reassessing US-Iran relations while the labor market remains resilient with falling unemployment claims and higher productivity, pointing to ongoing inflation risk.

items.summary: A fourth person has been arrested for the murder of a 17-year-old Kerala teenager named Abhiram. The victim was lured through Instagram, beaten, strangled, and his body was dumped in an abandoned plot; he was not the original target.
items.title_hi: केरल किशोर की हत्या में चौथा व्यक्ति गिरफ्तार। पीड़ित मूल लक्ष्य नहीं था
items.summary_hi: 17 वर्षीय अभिराम की हत्या में चौथे व्यक्ति को गिरफ्तार किया गया है। पीड़ित को इंस्टाग्राम के जरिए फुसलाया गया, पीटा गया और गला घोंटकर मार डाला गया। उसका शव बोरे में भरकर एक खाली प्लॉट में फेंक दिया गया। वह मूल लक्ष्य नहीं था।

items.title: Gokul row fuels Opposition's 'vote chori' campaign against Maharashtra govt
items.text: A political struggle has emerged over recent appointments to the Gokul Milk Cooperative by the state government. Opposition parties argue that this move undermines the democratic process established by the farmer elections. The Congress party claims that the government's actions represent an attempt to seize power through illegal means. Supporters of the government argue that the appointments are necessary to resolve a deadlock within the cooperative.
items.summary: A dispute over appointments to the Gokul Milk Cooperative has sparked Opposition accusations of vote theft against the Maharashtra government. Opposition parties say the appointments undermine farmer elections, while government supporters call them necessary to resolve a deadlock.
items.title_hi: गोकुल विवाद से महाराष्ट्र सरकार पर विपक्ष का 'वोट चोरी' अभियान
items.summary_hi: गोकुल दूध सहकारी समिति में नियुक्तियों पर विवाद ने महाराष्ट्र सरकार पर विपक्ष के 'वोट चोरी' आरोप भड़काए। विपक्ष का कहना है कि नियुक्तियां किसान चुनावों को कमजोर करती हैं, समर्थक इसे गतिरोध सुलझाने के लिए जरूरी बताते हैं।

items.title: Early Diwali cheer: Markets see fireworks; rupee rises, bond yields ease
items.text: The Nifty rose 2.4% to 24,536.60, while the Sensex gained 2.6%, as falling crude prices and strong foreign investor inflows lifted financial and auto stocks despite record DII selling.
items.summary: Indian markets rallied ahead of Diwali. The Nifty rose 2.4% to 24,536.60 and the Sensex gained 2.6%. Falling crude prices and strong foreign inflows lifted financial and auto stocks despite heavy domestic selling.

items.summary_hi: भारतीय बाजार दिवाली से पहले चढ़े। निफ्टी 2.4% बढ़कर 24,536.60 और सेंसेक्स 2.6% चढ़ा। कच्चे तेल के दाम गिरने और विदेशी निवेश के जोर से वित्तीय और ऑटो शेयर चढ़े, भारी घरेलू बिकवाली के बावजूद।

items.title: Britannia Q2 net profit rises 10.8% to ₹726 crore on volume growth
items.text: Bakery food company Britannia Industries Ltd on Thursday reported an increase of 10.82 per cent rise in consolidated net profit to Rs 725.99 crore for the September quarter of FY27, on a year-on-year basis, led by volume growth. The company had posted a net profit of Rs 655.06 crore in the July-September quarter a year ago, according to a regulatory filing from Britannia Industries. Britannia Industries' revenue from the sale of products was up 16.6 per cent to Rs 5,541.57 crore in the September quarter. The sales growth was "led by volume growth of 13 per cent", said Britannia Industries in i
items.summary: Britannia Industries' Q2 net profit rose 10.8% to ₹726 crore driven by volume growth. Revenue from product sales increased 16.6% to ₹5,542 crore, with volume growth of 13%.
items.title_hi: Britannia Q2 शुद्ध लाभ 10.8% बढ़कर ₹726 करोड़ वॉल्यूम ग्रोथ पर
items.summary_hi: Britannia Industries का Q2 शुद्ध लाभ 10.8% बढ़कर ₹726 करोड़ हुआ, जो वॉल्यूम ग्रोथ से प्रेरित है। उत्पाद बिक्री से राजस्व 16.6% बढ़कर ₹5,542 करोड़ हुआ, जिसमें 13% वॉल्यूम ग्रोथ रही।
items.key_numbers: Profit ₹726 cr (+10.8% YoY) · Revenue ₹5,542 cr (+16.6% YoY)

items.title: Reserve Bank of India may hike rates by up to 75 bps more: Uday Kotak
items.text: Uday Kotak expects another 50-75 basis points of repo rate hikes and warns of prolonged Middle East risks, but sees Indian equities well placed to attract foreign investors.
items.summary: Uday Kotak expects the Reserve Bank of India to raise the repo rate by another 50-75 basis points. He warns of prolonged risks from the Middle East but believes Indian equities are well positioned to attract foreign investors.
items.title_hi: भारतीय रिजर्व बैंक 75 आधार अंक तक दरें बढ़ा सकता है: उदय कोटक
items.summary_hi: उदय कोटक को उम्मीद है कि भारतीय रिजर्व बैंक रेपो दर में 50-75 आधार अंकों की और बढ़ोतरी करेगा। वे मध्य पूर्व के लंबे जोखिमों की चेतावनी देते हैं, लेकिन मानते हैं कि भारतीय इक्विटी विदेशी निवेशकों को आकर्षित करने के लिए अच्छी स्थिति में हैं।

items.title: Vijay's success makes more actors eye role in Tamil political theatre
items.text: Actor Dhanush has fuelled speculation about a possible political debut after renaming his fan club the Dhanush Welfare Movement and organising a meeting of female fans. Silver lamps bearing lotus emblems and a reported meeting with an RSS functionary have added to the chatter, though his organisation has denied political intent.
items.summary: Actor Dhanush has sparked political speculation after renaming his fan club and meeting female fans. Silver lamps with lotus emblems and a reported RSS meeting added to talk, but his organisation denies political intent.
items.title_hi: विजय की सफलता से अधिक अभिनेता तमिल राजनीति की ओर
items.summary_hi: अभिनेता धनुष ने फैन क्लब का नाम बदलकर और महिला प्रशंसकों की बैठक करके राजनीतिक अटकलें तेज कीं। कमल चिह्न वाले चांदी के दीपक और RSS पदाधिकारी से कथित मुलाकात ने चर्चा बढ़ाई, पर उनके संगठन ने राजनीतिक इरादे से इनकार किया।

items.title: Centre supports plea to deny perks to high office holders who quit to avoid removal
items.text: The Centre has expressed support for a public interest litigation regarding constitutional functionaries and their resignation benefits. The petition aims to prevent these functionaries from retaining perks upon resigning to evade removal proceedings. Solicitor General Tushar Mehta indicated the government would respond to the petition. The plea also argues that such provisions are arbitrary and violate constitutional rights. This legal action highlights the importance of accountability among high constitutional offices.
items.summary: The Centre supports a plea to deny perks to high office holders who resign to avoid removal. The petition aims to prevent functionaries from retaining perks when they quit to evade removal proceedings. Solicitor General Tushar Mehta indicated the government would respond.
items.title_hi: केंद्र ने उच्च पदाधिकारियों को हटाने से बचने के लिए इस्तीफा देने पर सुविधाएं न देने की याचिका का समर्थन किया
items.summary_hi: केंद्र ने उच्च पदाधिकारियों को हटाने से बचने के लिए इस्तीफा देने पर सुविधाएं न देने की याचिका का समर्थन किया। याचिका का उद्देश्य पदाधिकारियों को हटाने की कार्यवाही से बचने के लिए इस्तीफा देने पर सुविधाएं रखने से रोकना है। सॉलिसिटर जनरल तुषार मेहता ने संकेत दिया कि सरकार याचिका का जवाब देगी।

items.title: Supreme Court asks Calcutta High Court to fast-track plea against 10 rebel TMC MLAs
items.text: The Supreme Court asked the Calcutta High Court to urgently consider a plea seeking disqualification of 10 Trinamool Congress MLAs under the anti-defection law. Declining to entertain a direct disqualification petition, the apex court allowed senior TMC leader Sovandeb Chattopadhyay to approach the high court and requested expedited consideration by a division bench.
items.summary: The Supreme Court asked the Calcutta High Court to urgently hear a plea to disqualify 10 Trinamool Congress MLAs under the anti-defection law. The apex court declined to hear the disqualification petition directly and allowed a senior TMC leader to approach the high court.
items.title_hi: सुप्रीम कोर्ट ने कलकत्ता हाई कोर्ट से 10 बागी TMC विधायकों के खिलाफ याचिका तेजी से सुनने को कहा
items.summary_hi: सुप्रीम कोर्ट ने कलकत्ता हाई कोर्ट से 10 तृणमूल कांग्रेस विधायकों को दल-बदल कानून के तहत अयोग्य ठहराने की याचिका पर तत्काल सुनवाई करने को कहा। शीर्ष अदालत ने सीधे अयोग्यता याचिका पर सुनवाई से इनकार किया और एक वरिष्ठ TMC नेता को हाई कोर्ट जाने की अनुमति दी।

items.title: Supreme Court stays contempt proceedings against Punjab chief secretary over pending DA, DR dues
items.text: The Supreme Court stayed criminal contempt proceedings against Punjab Chief Secretary KAP Sinha and other officials over delays in clearing pending dearness allowance and relief dues of employees and pensioners. It also restrained coercive action in the civil contempt case and asked the state to specify how much arrears it can release by March 31, 2027.
items.summary: The Supreme Court stayed criminal contempt proceedings against Punjab Chief Secretary KAP Sinha and other officials over delays in clearing pending dearness allowance and relief dues. The court also restrained coercive action in the civil contempt case and asked the state to specify how much arrears it can release by March 31, 2027.

items.summary_hi: सुप्रीम कोर्ट ने पंजाब के मुख्य सचिव KAP सिन्हा और अन्य अधिकारियों के खिलाफ लंबित महंगाई भत्ते और राहत बकाया के भुगतान में देरी को लेकर आपराधिक अवमानना कार्यवाही पर रोक लगा दी। अदालत ने दीवानी अवमानना मामले में जबरदस्ती कार्रवाई पर भी रोक लगाई और राज्य से पूछा कि वह 31 मार्च 2027 तक कितना बकाया जारी कर सकता है।

items.text: A sharp sell-off hit chipmakers as disappointing forecasts from Qualcomm and Arm compounded worries about potential restrictions on AI data centres. AMD, Sandisk and Micron also fell heavily, while the semiconductor index dropped 9.7%.
items.summary: Chip stocks fell sharply as weak forecasts from Qualcomm and Arm added to concerns about AI data centre restrictions. The semiconductor index dropped 9.7% while AMD, Sandisk and Micron also declined heavily. Nasdaq fell 6% amid the sell-off.

items.text: Barring Maharashtra, prices declined by Rs 59-344 a quintal this week, when 1.99 lakh tonnes were offered
items.summary: FCI wheat sale prices fell in most major growing states this week as the government doubled the quantity offered. Maharashtra was the exception where prices did not decline.
items.title_hi: FCI के गेहूं बिक्री के दाम प्रमुख उत्पादक राज्यों में गिरे, भारत सरकार ने मात्रा दोगुनी की
items.summary_hi: इस हफ्ते FCI की गेहूं बिक्री के दाम ज्यादातर प्रमुख उत्पादक राज्यों में गिरे क्योंकि सरकार ने पेशकश की मात्रा दोगुनी कर दी। महाराष्ट्र को छोड़कर, दाम 59 से 344 रुपये प्रति क्विंटल तक घटे।

items.title: West Bengal unveils new investment policy, offers up to 120% assistance
items.text: The policy offers enhanced incentives for priority-sector investments, but excludes an estimated ₹50,000 crore backlog of industrial incentives promised under previous regimes
items.summary: West Bengal announced a new investment policy offering up to 120% assistance for priority sectors. The policy does not address an estimated ₹50,000 crore backlog of incentives promised earlier.
items.title_hi: पश्चिम बंगाल ने नई निवेश नीति पेश की, 120% तक सहायता का प्रस्ताव
items.summary_hi: पश्चिम बंगाल ने नई निवेश नीति की घोषणा की जिसमें प्राथमिकता वाले क्षेत्रों के लिए 120% तक सहायता दी गई है। लेकिन इसमें पिछली सरकारों के वादे के अनुसार अनुमानित ₹50,000 करोड़ के औद्योगिक प्रोत्साहन के बकाया का जिक्र नहीं है।

items.title: ‘Preparing for all UP seats’: Chirag Paswan’s response after another BJP ally’s warning
items.summary: Chirag Paswan stated he is preparing for all Uttar Pradesh seats in response to a warning from another BJP ally.
items.title_hi: ‘सभी यूपी सीटों की तैयारी’: एक और भाजपा सहयोगी की चेतावनी के बाद चिराग पासवान का जवाब
items.summary_hi: चिराग पासवान ने कहा कि वह एक अन्य भाजपा सहयोगी की चेतावनी के जवाब में उत्तर प्रदेश की सभी सीटों की तैयारी कर रहे हैं।

items.title: Q2 Results Today Highlights: M&M, NBCC, IPCA Lab, Bharat Forge, LG Electronics, Uno Minda & Amagi Media Q2 profit up, Samvardhana Motherson profit down q-o-q, Bharti Airtel, LIC, Titan, ONGC, Britannia, Prestige Estates, Fortis Healthcare, Abbott to announce Q2 results
items.text: Q2 Results Today, 05th November 2026 Highlights: businessline brings you the latest quarterly earnings, outlook and more.
items.summary: Multiple companies including M&M, NBCC, IPCA Lab and Bharat Forge reported higher Q2 profits while Samvardhana Motherson saw a quarterly decline. Bharti Airtel, LIC, Titan, ONGC and others are scheduled to announce their Q2 results.
items.title_hi: Q2 परिणाम आज: M&M, NBCC, IPCA लैब, भारत फोर्ज का मुनाफा बढ़ा, समवर्धना मदरसन का घटा; भारती एयरटेल, LIC, टाइटन, ONGC के परिणाम आने हैं
items.summary_hi: M&M, NBCC, IPCA लैब और भारत फोर्ज सहित कई कंपनियों का Q2 मुनाफा बढ़ा जबकि समवर्धना मदरसन का तिमाही आधार पर गिरा। भारती एयरटेल, LIC, टाइटन, ONGC और अन्य अपने Q2 परिणाम घोषित करेंगे।

items.title: Rupee closes at a 2-month high on possibility of de-escalation West Asia war, softening crude, weak dollar
items.text: Market watchers cited declining US yields, renewed risk appetite from foreign inflows, and bargain buying as the currency climbed for a fifth straight session, with eyes on nearby 94.00 support and 94.90 resistance
items.summary: The rupee reached a two-month high as West Asia tensions eased, crude oil prices softened and the dollar weakened. The currency rose for a fifth straight session with support near 94.00 and resistance at 94.90.
items.title_hi: रुपया 2 महीने के उच्च स्तर पर: पश्चिम एशिया में तनाव घटने, कच्चा तेल नरम और डॉलर कमजोर
items.summary_hi: रुपया दो महीने के उच्च स्तर पर पहुंचा क्योंकि पश्चिम एशिया में तनाव कम हुआ, कच्चा तेल नरम पड़ा और डॉलर कमजोर हुआ। मुद्रा लगातार पांचवें सत्र में चढ़ी और 94.00 सपोर्ट व 94.90 रेजिस्टेंस पर नजर है।

items.title: Centre advances ₹1.09 trillion tax devolution to states for November
items.text: Advance tax devolution aims to boost capital spending and meet development and welfare expenditure
items.summary: The Centre advanced ₹1.09 trillion in tax devolution to states for November. The advance aims to boost capital spending and meet development and welfare expenditure.
items.title_hi: केंद्र ने नवंबर के लिए राज्यों को ₹1.09 ट्रिलियन कर हस्तांतरण अग्रिम दिया
items.summary_hi: केंद्र ने नवंबर के लिए राज्यों को ₹1.09 ट्रिलियन का कर हस्तांतरण अग्रिम रूप से जारी किया। इसका उद्देश्य पूंजीगत खर्च बढ़ाना और विकास व कल्याणकारी व्यय पूरा करना है।

items.title: Godfrey Phillips Q2 profit down 37% to Rs 190 cr; revenue up twofold at Rs 4,198 cr
items.text: Godfrey Phillips India Ltd reported a significant 37.73 percent decrease in net profit for the September quarter, primarily driven by a substantial tax increase from the previous fiscal year. Despite this, the company's total consolidated income surged to Rs 8,139.64 crore during the first half of FY27. To counteract the volumetric impact from rising taxes, a tactical pricing strategy was implemented.
items.summary: Godfrey Phillips Q2 net profit declined 37% to ₹190 crore due to higher taxes. Revenue doubled to ₹4,198 crore.
items.title_hi: गॉडफ्रे फिलिप्स Q2 लाभ 37% गिरकर ₹190 करोड़; राजस्व दोगुना होकर ₹4,198 करोड़
items.summary_hi: गॉडफ्रे फिलिप्स का Q2 शुद्ध लाभ 37% गिरकर ₹190 करोड़ रहा, मुख्यतः अधिक टैक्स के कारण। राजस्व दोगुना होकर ₹4,198 करोड़ पहुंचा।
items.key_numbers: Profit ₹190 cr (−37% YoY) · Revenue ₹4,198 cr (+100% YoY)

items.title: Mumbai airport refuses summer slots for several West Asian airlines
items.text: The move has upset airlines who warn that such actions by MIAL could lead to reciprocal restrictions for Indian carriers
items.summary: Mumbai airport operator MIAL refused summer slots to several West Asian airlines. The airlines warn this could lead to reciprocal restrictions on Indian carriers.
items.title_hi: मुंबई हवाई अड्डे ने कई पश्चिम एशियाई एयरलाइनों को गर्मियों के स्लॉट देने से इनकार किया
items.summary_hi: मुंबई हवाई अड्डे के संचालक MIAL ने कई पश्चिम एशियाई एयरलाइनों को गर्मियों के स्लॉट देने से मना कर दिया। एयरलाइनों का कहना है कि इससे भारतीय एयरलाइनों पर जवाबी प्रतिबंध लग सकते हैं।

items.title: West Bengal’s new industrial policy offers employment-linked incentives for investors, dedicated support for large investment
items.text: Industry bodies and captains welcomed the new policy, stating that it is pragmatic, forward-looking and investor-friendly
items.summary: West Bengal has launched a new industrial policy with employment-linked incentives for investors. The policy provides dedicated support for large investments. Industry bodies have welcomed it as pragmatic and investor-friendly.
items.title_hi: पश्चिम बंगाल की नई औद्योगिक नीति निवेशकों के लिए रोजगार-लिंक्ड प्रोत्साहन, बड़े निवेश के लिए समर्पित समर्थन देती है
items.summary_hi: पश्चिम बंगाल ने निवेशकों के लिए रोजगार-लिंक्ड प्रोत्साहन के साथ नई औद्योगिक नीति शुरू की है। नीति बड़े निवेश के लिए समर्पित समर्थन देती है। उद्योग निकायों ने इसे व्यावहारिक और निवेशक-अनुकूल बताया है।

items.title: Apple seeks about $7 billion from bond sale, Bloomberg News reports
items.text: Apple is seeking about $7 billion from a US-dollar bond offering, Bloomberg News reported on Thursday, citing people familiar with the matter. The iPhone maker is the latest major tech company to tap debt markets as the sector raises large sums to fund AI expansion.
items.summary: Apple is seeking about $7 billion from a US-dollar bond offering. The iPhone maker is tapping debt markets to fund AI expansion.
items.title_hi: Apple बॉन्ड बिक्री से लगभग $7 बिलियन जुटाने की योजना बना रहा है
items.summary_hi: Apple US-डॉलर बॉन्ड पेशकश से लगभग $7 बिलियन जुटाने की योजना बना रहा है। iPhone निर्माता AI विस्तार के लिए कर्ज बाजार का उपयोग कर रहा है।

items.title: FPIs turn net buyers in the second half of October, shows data
items.text: Overseas investors bought heavily into IT and telecom stocks, but remained net sellers for October, with total equity outflows of ₹34,843 crore
items.summary: Foreign portfolio investors turned net buyers in the second half of October, heavily purchasing IT and telecom stocks. However, for the full month of October, they remained net sellers with total equity outflows of ₹34,843 crore.
items.title_hi: अक्टूबर के दूसरे पखवाड़े में FPI बने शुद्ध खरीदार, डेटा दिखाता है
items.summary_hi: विदेशी पोर्टफोलियो निवेशक अक्टूबर के दूसरे पखवाड़े में शुद्ध खरीदार बन गए, उन्होंने IT और टेलीकॉम शेयरों में भारी खरीदारी की। हालांकि, पूरे अक्टूबर महीने के लिए वे शुद्ध विक्रेता बने रहे, कुल ₹34,843 करोड़ का इक्विटी बहिर्वाह रहा।

items.title: Qualcomm shares slump 9% as weak smartphone chip sales overshadow data-center momentum
items.text: Qualcomm's shares dropped significantly in early trading following disappointing smartphone chip sales. The company's largest business segment faced a 26% revenue decline, leading to lower overall chip sales. While Qualcomm's investments in data-center and automotive chips strengthen its growth potential, analysts remain skeptical about immediate earnings. Brokerages have reduced their price targets on Qualcomm's stock after recent results were released.
items.summary: Qualcomm shares fell 9% after its smartphone chip business reported a 26% revenue decline. While data-center and automotive chip investments show long-term potential, analysts doubt near-term earnings improvement. Brokerages have cut price targets following the results.
items.title_hi: क्वालकॉम के शेयर 9% गिरे: कमजोर स्मार्टफोन चिप बिक्री ने डेटा-सेंटर ग्रोथ को पीछे छोड़ा
items.summary_hi: क्वालकॉम के शेयर 9% गिरे क्योंकि इसके सबसे बड़े सेगमेंट स्मार्टफोन चिप्स का राजस्व 26% घटा। डेटा-सेंटर और ऑटोमोटिव चिप्स में निवेश भविष्य के लिए अच्छा है पर विश्लेषक निकट भविष्य में कमाई सुधरने पर संदेह करते हैं। ब्रोकरेज ने टारगेट प्राइस घटाए हैं।

items.title: Fortis Q2 net profit falls 2.5% on higher expenses, lower exceptional gain
items.text: Fortis Healthcare's Q2FY27 net profit declined to ₹320 crore as expenses rose, while revenue grew 17 per cent to ₹2,735 crore, driven by hospitals and diagnostics
items.summary: Fortis Healthcare's net profit declined 2.5% to ₹320 crore in Q2FY27 due to higher expenses and lower exceptional gains. Revenue grew 17% to ₹2,735 crore driven by hospitals and diagnostics.
items.title_hi: फोर्टिस Q2: शुद्ध लाभ 2.5% गिरा, राजस्व 17% बढ़कर ₹2,735 करोड़
items.summary_hi: फोर्टिस हेल्थकेयर का Q2FY27 शुद्ध लाभ अधिक खर्च और कम असाधारण लाभ के कारण 2.5% घटकर ₹320 करोड़ रहा। अस्पतालों और डायग्नोस्टिक्स के दम पर राजस्व 17% बढ़कर ₹2,735 करोड़ हुआ।
items.key_numbers: Profit ₹320 cr (−2.5% YoY) · Revenue ₹2,735 cr (+17% YoY)

items.title: Jewellers expect fall in gold prices to boost Dhantera sales
items.text: Coins and bars are expected to lead sales, driven by investment sentiment and gifting traditions, say stakeholders
items.summary: Jewellers expect a fall in gold prices to boost sales during Dhanteras. Coins and bars are likely to lead the sales. Investment sentiment and gifting traditions are driving this expectation.
items.title_hi: जौहरी सोने की कीमतों में गिरावट से धनतेरस बिक्री बढ़ने की उम्मीद करते हैं
items.summary_hi: जौहरी सोने की कीमतों में गिरावट से धनतेरस की बिक्री बढ़ने की उम्मीद करते हैं। सिक्के और बार बिक्री में आगे रहने की संभावना है। निवेश भावना और उपहार परंपराएं इसे चला रही हैं।

items.title: Tax reporting lapses could risk India's sovereign rating, trigger withholding tax penalties: Income Tax Principal DG Debjyoti Das
items.text: Speaking to the media on the sidelines of the 'Summit on Global Financial Compliance (FATCA & CRS)' in Mumbai, Debjyoti Das, Principal Director General of Income Tax (Intelligence & Criminal Investigation), highlighted the growing risks associated with non-compliance in cross-border financial reporting.
items.summary: Income Tax Principal DG Debjyoti Das warned that tax reporting lapses could risk India's sovereign rating and trigger withholding tax penalties. He spoke at a summit on global financial compliance in Mumbai.
items.title_hi: कर रिपोर्टिंग में चूक भारत की संप्रभु रेटिंग को खतरे में डाल सकती है, स्रोत पर कर कटौती दंड लागू हो सकते हैं: आयकर प्रधान DG देबज्योति दास
items.summary_hi: मुंबई में वैश्विक वित्तीय अनुपालन शिखर सम्मेलन में बोलते हुए आयकर प्रधान महानिदेशक देबज्योति दास ने चेतावनी दी कि सीमा-पार वित्तीय रिपोर्टिंग में गैर-अनुपालन से भारत की संप्रभु रेटिंग को खतरा है और स्रोत पर कर कटौती के दंड लग सकते हैं।

items.title: Govt amends direct listing on international exchanges rules, expands definition of equity, eases restrictions
items.text: According to a notification by the Ministry, equity instruments now mean equity shares, convertible debentures, and preference shares issued by an Indian company
items.summary: The government has amended rules for direct listing on international exchanges. The definition of equity has been expanded to include equity shares, convertible debentures, and preference shares. Restrictions have been eased through a Ministry notification.
items.title_hi: सरकार ने अंतरराष्ट्रीय एक्सचेंजों पर डायरेक्ट लिस्टिंग के नियम संशोधित किए, इक्विटी की परिभाषा बढ़ाई, प्रतिबंध आसान किए
items.summary_hi: सरकार ने अंतरराष्ट्रीय एक्सचेंजों पर डायरेक्ट लिस्टिंग के नियम संशोधित किए हैं। इक्विटी की परिभाषा में अब इक्विटी शेयर, कन्वर्टिबल डिबेंचर और प्रेफरेंस शेयर शामिल हैं। मंत्रालय की अधिसूचना के जरिए प्रतिबंध आसान किए गए हैं।

items.title: Bodies of four fishermen from T.N. found near Kothapatnam beach in A.P.
items.text: Indian Coast Guard staff on search for five other missing fishermen who were sailing on the same boat which sank 2 km off the shore
items.summary: Bodies of four fishermen from Tamil Nadu were found near Kothapatnam beach in Andhra Pradesh. Indian Coast Guard is searching for five other missing fishermen from the same boat. The boat sank 2 km off the shore.
items.title_hi: तमिलनाडु के चार मछुआरों के शव आंध्र प्रदेश के कोठपट्टनम बीच के पास मिले
items.summary_hi: तमिलनाडु के चार मछुआरों के शव आंध्र प्रदेश के कोठपट्टनम बीच के पास मिले। भारतीय तटरक्षक उसी नाव के पांच अन्य लापता मछुआरों की तलाश कर रहा है। नाव तट से 2 किमी दूर डूबी थी।

items.title: Employees’ union protests against ‘attempts to destroy PSC’ in Keralam
items.text: CPI(M) State secretary M.V. Govindan accuses UDF government and a section of the media of continuing a slanderous attack on the PSC to facilitate contract appointments
items.summary: Employees' union is protesting against attempts to destroy the PSC in Kerala. CPI(M) state secretary M.V. Govindan accuses the UDF government and a section of media of slanderous attacks on PSC to facilitate contract appointments.
items.title_hi: कर्मचारी संघ ने केरलम में 'पीएससी को नष्ट करने के प्रयासों' के विरोध में प्रदर्शन किया
items.summary_hi: कर्मचारी संघ केरलम में पीएससी को नष्ट करने के प्रयासों के विरोध में प्रदर्शन कर रहा है। सीपीआई (एम) के राज्य सचिव एम.वी. गोविंदन ने यूडीएफ सरकार और मीडिया के एक वर्ग पर पीएससी पर बदनाम करने वाले हमले करने का आरोप लगाया है ताकि अनुबंध नियुक्तियों को सुविधाजनक बनाया जा सके।

items.title: Interstate marijuana trafficking racket operated by former security guard busted, five held after 60-day hunt
items.text: The network’s distribution model involved converting each kilogram of marijuana into about 150 small packets, which were sold for ₹300 each
items.summary: Police busted an interstate marijuana trafficking racket run by a former security guard. Five people were arrested after a 60-day hunt. The network sold about 150 small packets per kilogram at ₹300 each.
items.title_hi: पूर्व सुरक्षा गार्ड द्वारा चलाया जा रहा अंतरराज्यीय गांजा तस्करी रैकेट पकड़ा गया, 60 दिन की तलाश के बाद पांच गिरफ्तार
items.summary_hi: पुलिस ने एक पूर्व सुरक्षा गार्ड द्वारा चलाए जा रहे अंतरराज्यीय गांजा तस्करी रैकेट का भंडाफोड़ किया। 60 दिन की तलाश के बाद पांच लोगों को गिरफ्तार किया गया। नेटवर्क प्रति किलोग्राम लगभग 150 छोटे पैकेट ₹300 प्रत्येक पर बेचता था।

items.title: Newly elected KMC TDP corporators urge YSRCP to respect people’s mandate
items.text: They refute ward-23 rigging claims and urged the YSRCP leaders to withdraw their criticisms regarding the outcome and respect the mandate given by the people
items.summary: Newly elected KMC TDP corporators urged YSRCP to respect the people's mandate. They refuted ward-23 rigging claims and asked YSRCP leaders to withdraw their criticisms.

items.title: Sebi revises currency derivative norms for domestic investors, FPIs; allows to trade up to USD 5 mn
items.text: Sebi has revised its regulations to permit domestic and foreign portfolio investors to take positions in currency derivatives. Investors can now hold up to USD 5 million without establishing underlying exposure. The new guidelines also require FPIs to ensure their short positions do not exceed this limit. For amounts above the threshold, FPIs must have underlying exposure in Indian debt or equity securities.
items.summary: Sebi has changed currency derivative rules for domestic and foreign investors. They can now hold positions up to USD 5 million without proving underlying exposure. FPIs must keep short positions within this limit and need underlying exposure for larger amounts.
items.title_hi: सेबी ने घरेलू निवेशकों और एफपीआई के लिए मुद्रा डेरिवेटिव नियम बदले; 50 लाख डॉलर तक व्यापार की अनुमति
items.summary_hi: सेबी ने घरेलू और विदेशी निवेशकों के लिए मुद्रा डेरिवेटिव नियमों में बदलाव किया है। अब वे बिना अंडरलाइंग एक्सपोजर साबित किए 50 लाख डॉलर तक पोजीशन रख सकते हैं। एफपीआई को शॉर्ट पोजीशन इस सीमा के भीतर रखनी होगी और बड़ी रकम के लिए अंडरलाइंग एक्सपोजर जरूरी है।

items.summary: Nitin Gadkari accused Congress of trying to create anarchy due to election losses. He spoke at a BJP march in Nagpur and criticized language used by Congress leaders about PM Modi.

items.text: The Gurugram-based developer reported ₹820 crore in Q2FY27 revenue, while its adjusted Ebitda margin improved to 18 per cent from a negative 7 per cent a year earlier.
items.summary: Signature Global's Q2 net profit was ₹70 crore as revenue rose 148%. The company reported ₹820 crore revenue for Q2FY27, with adjusted EBITDA margin improving to 18% from -7% a year ago.

items.title: Fed's Beth Hammack favors gradual rate-hike path to lower inflation
items.text: Cleveland's Federal Reserve President Beth Hammack has emphasized the need for additional rate hikes to achieve the target inflation rate of 2%. She proposes implementing smaller, more frequent adjustments to minimize impacts on households and markets. Dissatisfied with the last Fed meeting's outcome, Hammack argues that the current monetary policy lacks sufficient restrictiveness.
items.summary: Cleveland Fed President Beth Hammack wants more rate hikes to reach 2% inflation target. She prefers smaller, frequent hikes to reduce impact on households and markets. She feels current policy is not restrictive enough.
items.title_hi: फेड की बेथ हैमैक धीरे-धीरे दरें बढ़ाकर महंगाई घटाने के पक्ष में

items.title_hi: भारत RE शिखर सम्मेलन ने भारत को विश्वसनीय विनिर्माण और तकनीकी भागीदार के रूप में स्थापित किया: सुमंत सिन्हा
items.summary_hi: भारत RE शिखर सम्मेलन ने भारत को विश्वसनीय विनिर्माण और तकनीकी भागीदार के रूप में स्थापित किया है। सुमंत सिन्हा कहते हैं कि भारत सबसे बड़े नवीकरणीय ऊर्जा बाजार से प्रतिस्पर्धी स्वच्छ ऊर्जा विनिर्माण केंद्र बन सकता है।

items.title: Goa SIR | Bombay High Court Orders ECI To Restore Names Of 6 Deleted Family Members Who Filed Form 8

items.title_hi: गोवा SIR | बॉम्बे हाई कोर्ट ने ECI को 6 हटाए गए परिवार सदस्यों के नाम बहाल करने का आदेश दिया जिन्होंने फॉर्म 8 भरा था

items.title: ECI Must Accept Form 8 For Voters' Change Of Address Even During SIR; Can't Ask Them To File Form 6 : Bombay High Court
items.text: The SIR process does not suspend the statutory forms, the Court stated.
items.summary: Bombay High Court ruled that the Election Commission must accept Form 8 for voters' change of address even during the SIR process. The court stated that the SIR process does not suspend statutory forms, so voters cannot be asked to file Form 6 instead.
items.title_hi: ECI को SIR के दौरान भी मतदाताओं के पते बदलने के लिए फॉर्म 8 स्वीकार करना होगा; फॉर्म 6 दाखिल करने को नहीं कह सकते : बॉम्बे हाई कोर्ट
items.summary_hi: बॉम्बे हाई कोर्ट ने फैसला दिया कि ECI को SIR प्रक्रिया के दौरान भी मतदाताओं के पते बदलने के लिए फॉर्म 8 स्वीकार करना होगा। कोर्ट ने कहा कि SIR प्रक्रिया वैधानिक फॉर्म को निलंबित नहीं करती, इसलिए मतदाताओं को फॉर्म 6 दाखिल करने के लिए नहीं कहा जा सकता।

items.title: Centre issues advisory to states to boost fodder production, livestock infra under VB-G RAM G
items.text: The Centre has issued an advisory to states and Union territories to improve fodder security and livestock infrastructure. This advisory promotes convergence under the Viksit Bharat-Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission Act, 2025. It identifies 22 permissible works supporting fodder cultivation, livestock shelters, and veterinary health facilities. States are encouraged to increase expenditure on these works while aligning with local development priorities.
