items.title: Centre proposing parity in mineral taxation, states' rights to remain intact: Union Mines Secretary
items.text: Proposed amendments to the Mines and Minerals (Development and Regulation) Act are intended to create tax parity across states. This initiative aims to reduce reliance on imports by fostering local production and processing of critical minerals. The Indian government has introduced significant subsidies to support industries establishing lithium and nickel processing facilities. Approximately 58 entities are now registered under a recycling program for electronic waste.
items.summary: The Centre proposes amendments to the Mines and Minerals Act to create tax parity across states. This aims to reduce import reliance by boosting local production of critical minerals. items.title: US midterm outcome offers limited relief to India; oil, Russia sanctions remain key risks: Report
items.text: The outcome of the US midterm elections is expected to offer only marginal relief to India. Crude oil prices and potential tariffs on Russian oil purchases will continue to present economic challenges. While a Democratic majority may enhance diplomatic engagement, immediate trade relief seems unlikely. The rupee and foreign portfolio investor inflows could see some positive impact.
items.summary: The US midterm election outcome offers only limited relief to India. Crude oil prices and potential Russian oil sanctions remain key economic risks. A Democratic majority may improve diplomatic engagement but immediate trade relief is unlikely.

items.summary: Kiren Rijiju criticised Rahul Gandhi and Congress leaders for demanding an open debate with the Prime Minister. He suggested they spend more time in India and listed conditions for Congress to win more MPs.

items.title: Alcohol stocks jump as blue wave boosts industry prospects
items.text: As the midterm elections unfold, investors are directing their focus to the alcohol sector, anticipating positive impacts on companies such as Constellation Brands due to shifting immigration policies. Optimism surrounding decreasing trade tensions with Canada also seems to uplift brands like Brown-Forman. However, the looming tariffs have caused a sharp decline in US spirits exports, and overall alcohol consumption in the country is still at historical lows, despite minor upticks.
items.summary: Alcohol stocks jumped as investors anticipate positive impacts from midterm election results. Companies like Constellation Brands may benefit from shifting immigration policies. However, looming tariffs have caused a sharp decline in US spirits exports and overall alcohol consumption remains at historical lows.

items.title: Morocco King Presses for Peacekeeper Pullout From Western Sahara
items.text: Morocco’s King Mohammed VI ordered authorities to help speed the withdrawal of United Nations peacekeepers from the disputed Western Sahara after a diplomatic standoff between the US and Russia meant the 35-year-old mission wasn’t renewed.
items.summary: Morocco's King Mohammed VI ordered authorities to speed up the withdrawal of UN peacekeepers from Western Sahara. The 35-year-old mission was not renewed after a diplomatic standoff between the US and Russia.
items.title_hi: मोरक्को के राजा ने पश्चिमी सहारा से शांति सैनिकों की वापसी के लिए दबाव डाला

items.title: Musk stocks lose $120 billion as Democrats’ Texas win rattles investors
items.text: Tesla and SpaceX lost more than $120 billion in combined market value after Democrats scored major election victories in Texas and across the US. Investors are concerned that a Democrat-controlled Congress could increase scrutiny of Elon Musk’s businesses, complicate a potential Tesla-SpaceX merger and create fresh regulatory hurdles.
items.summary: Tesla and SpaceX lost over $120 billion in market value after Democrats won major elections in Texas and across the US. Investors fear more regulatory scrutiny of Elon Musk's businesses.
items.title_hi: मस्क के शेयरों को $120 बिलियन का नुकसान, डेमोक्रेट्स की टेक्सास जीत से निवेशक चिंतित

items.title: Bitcoin rebounds with stocks despite threat to crypto agenda
items.text: Bitcoin rebounds more than 4% to above $81,000, tracking a broader recovery in financial markets after the US midterm elections. However, Democratic control of Congress threatens to stall crypto-friendly legislation and increase regulatory scrutiny. Investors are also weighing the impact of political uncertainty, Treasury yields and institutional adoption.
items.summary: Bitcoin rose over 4% to above $81,000 as financial markets recovered after US midterm elections. Democratic control of Congress may delay crypto-friendly laws and increase regulation. Investors are watching political uncertainty, Treasury yields, and institutional adoption.

items.title: Big factories dominate India's manufacturing output, Annual Survey of Industries shows
items.text: India's manufacturing sector is characterized by a significant concentration in large factories generating substantial output. Factories producing over ₹500 crore contribute to more than three-fifths of total value added. Smaller factories represent a large number but have minimal output and value contribution. The overall manufacturing corporate sector experienced a notable growth in gross value added year-on-year. However, per-worker value creation did not witness similar growth despite increased employment.
items.summary: The Annual Survey of Industries shows big factories dominate India's manufacturing output. Factories producing over ₹500 crore contribute more than three-fifths of total value added, while smaller factories are numerous but contribute little. The sector grew in gross value added year-on-year, but per-worker value creation did not grow similarly despite more employment.
items.title_hi: वार्षिक उद्योग सर्वेक्षण: बड़ी फैक्ट्रियों का विनिर्माण उत्पादन पर दबदबा
items.summary_hi: वार्षिक उद्योग सर्वेक्षण दिखाता है कि बड़ी फैक्ट्रियां भारत के विनिर्माण उत्पादन पर हावी हैं। ₹500 करोड़ से अधिक उत्पादन वाली फैक्ट्रियां कुल मूल्य वर्धन का तीन-पांचवां हिस्सा देती हैं, जबकि छोटी फैक्ट्रियां संख्या में ज्यादा हैं पर योगदान कम। क्षेत्र का सकल मूल्य वर्धन साल-दर-साल बढ़ा, लेकिन प्रति कर्मचारी मूल्य सृजन रोजगार बढ़ने के बावजूद नहीं बढ़ा।

items.title: Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla calls for debate, discussions in House amid opposition heat
items.text: Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla highlighted the necessity of discussions in democracy while addressing ongoing opposition protests against the Election Commission. The Speaker urged Parliament to engage in fruitful debates on various issues. He noted that the disqualification proceedings against 20 MPs aligned with the NDA are still under examination. Additionally, Birla is reviewing a notice about chief secretaries' absence from a hearing on scholarship irregularities.
items.summary: Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla stressed the need for debates in democracy while addressing opposition protests against the Election Commission. He noted disqualification proceedings against 20 NDA-aligned MPs are under examination and is reviewing a notice about chief secretaries' absence from a hearing on scholarship irregularities.
items.title_hi: लोकसभा अध्यक्ष ओम बिरला ने विपक्ष के हंगामे के बीच सदन में बहस का आह्वान किया
items.summary_hi: लोकसभा अध्यक्ष ओम बिरला ने लोकतंत्र में बहस की आवश्यकता पर जोर दिया जबकि चुनाव आयोग के खिलाफ विपक्ष के विरोध को संबोधित किया। उन्होंने बताया कि NDA से जुड़े 20 सांसदों की अयोग्यता कार्यवाही जांच के अधीन है और मुख्य सचिवों की छात्रवृत्ति अनियमितताओं की सुनवाई में अनुपस्थिति पर नोटिस की समीक्षा कर रहे हैं।

items.title: Cummins India Q2 results: Revenue at ₹3,247 crore led by growth in domestic and export markets
items.summary: Cummins India reported Q2 revenue of ₹3,247 crore driven by growth in domestic and export markets.
items.title_hi: कमिंस इंडिया Q2 नतीजे: घरेलू और निर्यात बाजारों में वृद्धि से ₹3,247 करोड़ राजस्व
items.summary_hi: कमिंस इंडिया ने Q2 में ₹3,247 करोड़ का राजस्व दर्ज किया, जो घरेलू और निर्यात बाजारों में वृद्धि से प्रेरित है।

items.title: Vijay Says Meeting With School Toppers In Chennai Not About Politics
items.text: The Madras High Court had recently made strong observations about the use of children in TVK's political campaigns, describing it as being in bad taste. The remarks had brought renewed scrutiny on the party's engagement with children.
items.summary: Vijay stated that a meeting with school toppers in Chennai was not political. The Madras High Court had recently criticised the use of children in TVK's political campaigns as being in bad taste.
items.title_hi: विजय ने कहा चेन्नई में स्कूल टॉपर्स से मुलाकात राजनीति के बारे में नहीं
items.summary_hi: विजय ने कहा कि चेन्नई में स्कूल टॉपर्स के साथ बैठक राजनीतिक नहीं थी। मद्रास हाई कोर्ट ने हाल ही में TVK के राजनीतिक अभियानों में बच्चों के उपयोग को खराब बताया था।

items.title: New orders & robust demand lift India's October services growth to 4-month high
items.text: Growth in India's services sector increased to a four-month high in October due to strong domestic demand and business orders. The HSBC Services Business Activity Index rose to 55.8, reflecting improved business conditions. Conversely, manufacturing activity showed a slight decline, easing to a PMI of 54.7. While input prices continued to rise, the rate of increase was the slowest in over six years.
items.summary: India's services sector growth hit a four-month high in October with the HSBC Services Business Activity Index at 55.8. Manufacturing PMI eased slightly to 54.7 while input price rises slowed to a six-year low.
items.title_hi: नए ऑर्डर और मजबूत मांग से भारत की अक्टूबर सेवा वृद्धि 4 महीने के उच्च स्तर पर
items.summary_hi: मजबूत घरेलू मांग और व्यावसायिक ऑर्डर से अक्टूबर में सेवा क्षेत्र की वृद्धि चार महीने के उच्च स्तर पर पहुंची। HSBC सेवा सूचकांक 55.8 पर रहा। विनिर्माण PMI मामूली गिरकर 54.7 पर आया जबकि लागत मूल्य वृद्धि छह साल में सबसे धीमी रही।

items.title: How US Polls Can Change The World For Trump: Foreign Policy Editor Explains
items.text: "Countries and companies around the world -- they see when a leader is weakening, they are going to adapt how they approach the Trump administration," Ravi Agrawal said.
items.summary: Foreign Policy editor Ravi Agrawal explained that countries and companies adjust their approach to the Trump administration when they perceive a leader as weakening. He suggested that US polls can influence how the world engages with Trump's foreign policy.
items.title_hi: अमेरिकी चुनाव ट्रंप के लिए दुनिया कैसे बदल सकते हैं: विदेश नीति संपादक ने समझाया
items.summary_hi: विदेश नीति के संपादक रवि अग्रवाल ने समझाया कि जब देश और कंपनियां किसी नेता को कमजोर होते देखती हैं, तो वे ट्रंप प्रशासन के प्रति अपना दृष्टिकोण बदल लेती हैं। उन्होंने सुझाव दिया कि अमेरिकी चुनाव इस बात को प्रभावित कर सकते हैं कि दुनिया ट्रंप की विदेश नीति से कैसे जुड़ती है।

items.title: Gujarat HC dismisses plea against NCLT order in insolvency case
items.summary: Gujarat High Court has dismissed a plea challenging an NCLT order in an insolvency case.
items.title_hi: गुजरात HC ने दिवालिया मामले में NCLT आदेश के खिलाफ याचिका खारिज की
items.summary_hi: गुजरात उच्च न्यायालय ने दिवालिया मामले में NCLT के आदेश को चुनौती देने वाली याचिका खारिज कर दी है।

items.title: "Could Smell Alcohol On Him": Rahul Gandhi Attacks Bhagwant Mann, AAP Reacts
items.text: Rahul Gandhi said that Punjab needed a leader who genuinely understood the suffering caused by drugs and was personally committed for the issue.
items.summary: Rahul Gandhi attacked Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann, alleging he could smell alcohol on him. Gandhi said Punjab needs a leader who genuinely understands drug-related suffering and is personally committed to the issue. AAP reacted to the remarks.
items.title_hi: "उनसे शराब की गंध आ रही थी": राहुल गांधी ने भगवंत मान पर हमला किया, AAP ने प्रतिक्रिया दी
items.summary_hi: राहुल गांधी ने पंजाब के मुख्यमंत्री भगवंत मान पर हमला करते हुए आरोप लगाया कि उनसे शराब की गंध आ रही थी। गांधी ने कहा कि पंजाब को एक ऐसे नेता की जरूरत है जो नशीली दवाओं से होने वाली पीड़ा को वास्तव में समझता हो और इस मुद्दे के लिए व्यक्तिगत रूप से प्रतिबद्ध हो। AAP ने इस टिप्पणी पर प्रतिक्रिया दी।

items.title: Man Accuses Wife, Mother-In-Law Of Forced Circumcision In Assam
items.text: The complainant, Akhil Kumar Chandak, has lodged an FIR at the Bhangagarh Police Station against his 24-year-old wife, Nurshika Begum, and her 36-year-old mother, Nur Khatun.
items.summary: A man in Assam filed a police complaint accusing his wife and mother-in-law of forced circumcision. Akhil Kumar Chandak lodged the FIR at Bhangagarh Police Station. The accused are his 24-year-old wife Nurshika Begum and her 36-year-old mother Nur Khatun.
items.title_hi: असम में व्यक्ति ने पत्नी और सास पर जबरन खतना का आरोप लगाया
items.summary_hi: असम में एक व्यक्ति ने अपनी पत्नी और सास पर जबरन खतना कराने का आरोप लगाते हुए पुलिस शिकायत दर्ज की। अखिल कुमार चंदक ने भांगरगढ़ पुलिस स्टेशन में FIR दर्ज कराई। आरोपी उनकी 24 वर्षीय पत्नी नूरशिका बेगम और 36 वर्षीय सास नूर खातून हैं।

items.title: Supreme Court Daily Round-Up : November 4, 2026
items.summary: This is a daily round-up of Supreme Court activities for November 4, 2026.

items.title: US slaps sanctions on Indian, Turkish firms and people for aiding Iran
items.text: The sanctions are part of the Trump administration's "Operation Economic Outcast," which aims to cut off Iran's ability to sell oil to fund the war with the US and Israel. Treasury unveiled the new sanctions a day after Democrats made huge gains in midterm elections, winning control of both houses of Congress as voters expressed anger about the Iran war and its impact in fueling US inflation.
items.summary: The US has imposed sanctions on Indian and Turkish firms and individuals for helping Iran. The sanctions are part of the Trump administration's Operation Economic Outcast, which aims to cut off Iran's oil revenue. The move came a day after Democrats won control of both houses of Congress in midterm elections.
items.title_hi: अमेरिका ने ईरान की मदद करने वाली भारतीय और तुर्की फर्मों और लोगों पर प्रतिबंध लगाए
items.summary_hi: अमेरिका ने ईरान की मदद करने वाली भारतीय और तुर्की फर्मों और व्यक्तियों पर प्रतिबंध लगा दिए हैं। ये प्रतिबंध ट्रम्प प्रशासन के "ऑपरेशन इकोनॉमिक आउटकास्ट" का हिस्सा हैं, जिसका उद्देश्य ईरान के तेल राजस्व को रोकना है। यह कदम मध्यावधि चुनावों में डेमोक्रेट्स द्वारा कांग्रेस के दोनों सदनों पर नियंत्रण हासिल करने के एक दिन बाद आया।

items.title: Trump's midterm setback may give India an edge in trade deal
items.text: US has sought to allay concerns that the Republicans’ midterm election defeat could derail trade talks with India, with an American embassy spokesperson saying that President Donald Trump remains firmly in charge of Washington’s trade agenda
items.summary: The US embassy said President Trump remains in charge of trade policy despite Republican midterm losses. This may give India an advantage in ongoing trade talks.
items.title_hi: ट्रंप के मध्यावधि झटके से भारत को व्यापार सौदे में बढ़त मिल सकती है
items.summary_hi: अमेरिकी दूतावास ने कहा कि मध्यावधि चुनाव में रिपब्लिकन की हार के बावजूद राष्ट्रपति ट्रंप व्यापार नीति के प्रमुख बने हुए हैं। इससे भारत को चल रही व्यापार वार्ता में लाभ हो सकता है।

items.title: Congress accuses Dhami govt of giving prime Uttarakhand land, George Everest Estate to private parties
items.text: Congress has accused the BJP government in poll-bound Uttarakhand of corrupt land dealings. Allegations include selling government land and heritage sites at low prices. AICC general secretary Kumari Selja stated that chief minister PS Dhami approved these land transfers. The opposition party plans to agitate in the state and approach the governor. They claim these decisions were facilitated by the Uttarakhand Investment and Infrastructure Development Board.
items.summary: Congress has accused the BJP government in Uttarakhand of corrupt land dealings, including selling prime land and heritage sites like George Everest Estate at low prices to private parties. AICC general secretary Kumari Selja alleged that Chief Minister PS Dhami approved these transfers. The opposition plans to protest in the state and approach the governor, claiming the Uttarakhand Investment and Infrastructure Development Board facilitated these decisions.
items.title_hi: कांग्रेस ने धामी सरकार पर उत्तराखंड की प्रमुख जमीन, जॉर्ज एवरेस्ट एस्टेट निजी पार्टियों को देने का आरोप लगाया
items.summary_hi: कांग्रेस ने उत्तराखंड में भाजपा सरकार पर भ्रष्ट भूमि सौदों का आरोप लगाया है, जिसमें जॉर्ज एवरेस्ट एस्टेट जैसी प्रमुख भूमि और विरासत स्थलों को कम कीमतों पर निजी पार्टियों को बेचना शामिल है। एआईसीसी महासचिव कुमारी शैलजा ने आरोप लगाया कि मुख्यमंत्री पीएस धामी ने इन तबादलों को मंजूरी दी। विपक्ष राज्य में विरोध प्रदर्शन करने और राज्यपाल से मिलने की योजना बना रहा है, उनका दावा है कि उत्तराखंड निवेश और बुनियादी ढांचा विकास बोर्ड ने इन फैसलों को सुविधाजनक बनाया।

items.title: RSS defends SIR as necessary for accurate voter lists, urges dialogue with youth amid protests
items.text: RSS general secretary Dattatreya Hosabale defended the ongoing SIR, stating that it is essential for accurate voter lists. While opposition parties and youth groups protest against the exercise, Hosabale claimed that some forces aim to incite unrest and violence. He emphasized that political change must occur through elections, not through disruptions. The government is urged to engage in dialogue to address youth aspirations and concerns.
items.summary: RSS general secretary Dattatreya Hosabale defended the ongoing SIR exercise as necessary for accurate voter lists. He claimed some forces aim to incite unrest amid protests by opposition parties and youth groups. Hosabale emphasized political change should occur through elections, not disruptions, and urged the government to dialogue with youth.
items.title_hi: आरएसएस ने सटीक मतदाता सूचियों के लिए SIR को आवश्यक बताया, विरोध के बीच युवाओं से संवाद का आग्रह किया
items.summary_hi: आरएसएस महासचिव दत्तात्रेय होसबाले ने चल रहे SIR अभ्यास का बचाव किया, कहा कि यह सटीक मतदाता सूचियों के लिए आवश्यक है। उन्होंने दावा किया कि कुछ ताकतें विरोध कर रहे विपक्षी दलों और युवा समूहों के बीच अशांति भड़काना चाहती हैं। होसबाले ने जोर दिया कि राजनीतिक परिवर्तन चुनावों के माध्यम से होना चाहिए, व्यवधानों के माध्यम से नहीं, और सरकार से युवाओं की आकांक्षाओं और चिंताओं को दूर करने के लिए संवाद करने का आग्रह किया।

items.title: Will tighter AI regulation slow Big Tech spending? What the US midterm results mean for tech stocks - Explained
items.text: Wall Street reacted unevenly to Democratic gains in Congress: Amazon, Meta, Alphabet, Microsoft and Apple rallied, while several AI-chip, memory and data-centre stocks fell. Investors weighed hopes of moderated spending against the possibility of tighter AI and data-centre oversight.
items.summary: US midterm results led to mixed reactions in tech stocks. Big tech companies like Amazon, Meta, Alphabet, Microsoft and Apple rose, while AI chip and data centre stocks fell. Investors are weighing possible tighter AI regulation against moderated spending hopes.
items.title_hi: क्या सख्त AI नियमन बिग टेक खर्च धीमा करेगा? अमेरिकी मध्यावधि नतीजों का टेक शेयरों पर असर
items.summary_hi: अमेरिकी मध्यावधि नतीजों से टेक शेयरों में मिली-जुली प्रतिक्रिया हुई। अमेजन, मेटा, अल्फाबेट, माइक्रोसॉफ्ट और एप्पल के शेयर चढ़े, जबकि AI चिप और डेटा सेंटर शेयर गिरे। निवेशक सख्त AI नियमन की संभावना और खर्च में नरमी की उम्मीद के बीच तौल रहे हैं।

items.title: Apollo Hospitals Q2 net profit rises 32% to ₹630 crore; revenue up 23%
items.text: Apollo Hospitals reported a 32 per cent rise in Q2FY27 net profit to ₹630 crore, supported by strong hospital growth, higher international patient inflows and improved performance across segments
items.summary: Apollo Hospitals Q2 net profit rose 32% to ₹630 crore. Revenue increased 23% supported by strong hospital growth and higher international patient inflows.
items.title_hi: अपोलो हॉस्पिटल्स Q2 शुद्ध लाभ 32% बढ़कर ₹630 करोड़; राजस्व 23% बढ़ा
items.summary_hi: अपोलो हॉस्पिटल्स का Q2 शुद्ध लाभ 32% बढ़कर ₹630 करोड़ हुआ। मजबूत अस्पताल वृद्धि और अधिक अंतरराष्ट्रीय रोगी आवक से राजस्व 23% बढ़ा।

items.title: Explained: Why could a weak monsoon derail India's ambitious ethanol blending programme?
items.text: India’s weak monsoon and rising food prices are putting food security ahead of ethanol production, potentially pushing the country’s fuel-blending rate below its 20% target and increasing reliance on imported crude.
items.summary: A weak monsoon and rising food prices are putting food security ahead of ethanol production. This could push India's fuel-blending rate below the 20% target and increase reliance on imported crude.
items.title_hi: कमजोर मानसून कैसे भारत के महत्वाकांक्षी एथनॉल मिश्रण कार्यक्रम को पटरी से उतार सकता है
items.summary_hi: कमजोर मानसून और बढ़ती खाद्य कीमतों ने खाद्य सुरक्षा को एथनॉल उत्पादन से ऊपर रखा है। इससे ईंधन-मिश्रण दर 20% के लक्ष्य से नीचे जा सकती है और आयातित कच्चे तेल पर निर्भरता बढ़ सकती है।

items.title: Despite gains since October, rupee still trails its Asian peers in 2026
items.text: Rupee gains 1.25% since October after RBI curbs speculative bets, but remains down over 5% against the dollar in 2026
items.summary: The rupee has gained 1.25% since October after RBI curbs on speculative bets. It is still down over 5% against the dollar in 2026 and trails Asian peers.
items.title_hi: अक्टूबर से बढ़त के बावजूद 2026 में रुपया एशियाई साथियों से पीछे
items.summary_hi: आरबीआई की सट्टेबाजी पर रोक के बाद अक्टूबर से रुपया 1.25% मजबूत हुआ है। फिर भी 2026 में यह डॉलर के मुकाबले 5% से अधिक नीचे है और एशियाई मुद्राओं से पीछे चल रहा है।

items.title: 4 Militants Killed As Rival Groups Clash In Manipur Village
items.text: Police sources said three of the dead belonged to the Zeliangrong United Front (Jenchui faction), or ZUF(J), and one to the National Socialist Council of Nagalim (NSCN-IM). The clash took place at Taodaizing village on Wednesday.
items.summary: Four militants were killed in a clash between rival groups at a village in Manipur. Police said three belonged to the Zeliangrong United Front (Jenchui faction) and one to the National Socialist Council of Nagalim (NSCN-IM).
items.title_hi: मणिपुर के गांव में प्रतिद्वंद्वी गुटों की झड़प में 4 उग्रवादी मारे गए
items.summary_hi: मणिपुर के एक गांव में प्रतिद्वंद्वी गुटों की झड़प में चार उग्रवादी मारे गए। पुलिस के अनुसार तीन जेलियांग्रोंग यूनाइटेड फ्रंट (जेंचुई गुट) के थे और एक एनएससीएन-आईएम का था।

items.title: Allcargo Terminals Q2 Results: Profit Nearly Doubles, Revenue Jumps 22%
items.summary: Allcargo Terminals Q2 profit nearly doubled while revenue jumped 22%.
items.title_hi: ऑलकार्गो टर्मिनल्स Q2 नतीजे: लाभ लगभग दोगुना, राजस्व 22% बढ़ा
items.summary_hi: ऑलकार्गो टर्मिनल्स का Q2 लाभ लगभग दोगुना हुआ जबकि राजस्व 22% बढ़ा।

items.title: Over half of street vendors may cut UPI acceptance if 0.4% MDR is introduced: ISB study
items.text: More than 67% of street vendors in India currently accept UPI payments for transactions. A proposed 0.4% merchant discount rate could lead to reduced acceptance among vendors. Concerns arise particularly for vendor-supplier transactions, as many vendors make payments above ₹2,000. A significant portion of vendors faced additional charges from suppliers and might pass costs onto customers.
items.summary: An ISB study finds that over half of street vendors may stop accepting UPI if a 0.4% merchant discount rate is introduced. Currently, more than 67% of street vendors accept UPI payments. Vendors worry about costs for transactions above ₹2,000 and may pass charges to customers.
items.title_hi: आईएसबी अध्ययन: 0.4% एमडीआर लागू हुआ तो आधे से अधिक स्ट्रीट वेंडर यूपीआई स्वीकार करना बंद कर सकते हैं
items.summary_hi: आईएसबी अध्ययन के अनुसार, यदि 0.4% एमडीआर लागू होता है तो आधे से अधिक स्ट्रीट वेंडर यूपीआई लेना बंद कर सकते हैं। वर्तमान में 67% से अधिक वेंडर यूपीआई स्वीकार करते हैं। ₹2,000 से ऊपर के लेनदेन पर लागत की चिंता है और वेंडर ग्राहकों पर शुल्क लगा सकते हैं।

items.title: 6 Arrested by Assam Police In Fraud Case, Pak Link Under Scanner
items.text: STF Senior Superintendent of Police revealed that the crackdown was initiated after they received intelligence inputs regarding a cross-border financial syndicate.
items.summary: Assam Police arrested six people in a fraud case with a suspected Pakistan link. The Special Task Force acted on intelligence about a cross-border financial syndicate.
items.title_hi: असम पुलिस ने धोखाधड़ी मामले में 6 गिरफ्तार किए, पाक कनेक्शन की जांच
items.summary_hi: असम पुलिस ने धोखाधड़ी के एक मामले में छह लोगों को गिरफ्तार किया जिसमें पाकिस्तान का संबंध होने का संदेह है। स्पेशल टास्क फोर्स ने सीमा-पार वित्तीय सिंडिकेट की खुफिया जानकारी पर कार्रवाई की।

items.title: Markets extend gains on US midterm results as Democrats sweep elections
items.text: The Nifty gains 5.6% in five sessions, with media, metals and realty stocks leading the rally, even as IT shares decline amid AI-related concerns
items.summary: The Nifty gained 5.6% in five sessions led by media, metals and realty stocks. IT shares declined amid AI-related concerns.
items.title_hi: डेमोक्रेट्स के चुनाव जीतने पर अमेरिकी मध्यावधि परिणामों से बाजार में बढ़त जारी
items.summary_hi: निफ्टी पांच सत्रों में 5.6% बढ़ा, जिसका नेतृत्व मीडिया, धातु और रियल्टी स्टॉक्स ने किया। AI-संबंधी चिंताओं के बीच IT शेयरों में गिरावट आई।

items.title: Gold up 3%; experts split on whether rally can sustain in coming months
items.text: Weakness in the dollar and US Treasury yields supports recovery, but analysts differ on whether the rally can sustain amid inflation and interest rate uncertainties
items.summary: Gold prices rose 3% due to a weaker dollar and lower US Treasury yields. Experts disagree on whether the rally will continue given inflation and interest rate uncertainty.
items.title_hi: सोना 3% चढ़ा; विशेषज्ञों में मतभेद कि तेजी बनी रहेगी या नहीं
items.summary_hi: कमजोर डॉलर और घटते अमेरिकी ट्रेजरी यील्ड से सोना 3% बढ़ा। विशेषज्ञ इस बात पर बंटे हैं कि महंगाई और ब्याज दरों की अनिश्चितता के बीच यह तेजी टिकेगी या नहीं।

items.title: New entrants eat into SIP inflows of listed Mutual funds
items.text: The monthly SIP inflows of ICICI Prudential AMC peaked to ₹5,104 crore in March quarter and dipped to ₹4,872 crore in June quarter and further to ₹4,672 crore in September quarter
items.summary: Monthly SIP inflows of ICICI Prudential AMC peaked at ₹5,104 crore in March quarter and dipped to ₹4,872 crore in June quarter and further to ₹4,672 crore in September quarter.
items.title_hi: नए प्रवेशकों ने सूचीबद्ध म्यूचुअल फंड्स के SIP इनफ्लो में सेंध लगाई
items.summary_hi: ICICI प्रूडेंशियल AMC का मासिक SIP इनफ्लो मार्च तिमाही में ₹5,104 करोड़ पर चरम पर था और जून तिमाही में ₹4,872 करोड़ और सितंबर तिमाही में ₹4,672 करोड़ तक गिर गया।

items.title: SBI vs SBI Life vs SBI Cards: Which SBI Group stock emerged as the Q2 results 2026 winner? Check technical targets
items.summary: Article compares Q2 results of SBI, SBI Life and SBI Cards to determine which SBI Group stock performed best.
items.title_hi: SBI बनाम SBI लाइफ बनाम SBI कार्ड्स: Q2 नतीजों 2026 में कौन सा SBI ग्रुप स्टॉक विजेता रहा?
items.summary_hi: लेख SBI, SBI लाइफ और SBI कार्ड्स के Q2 नतीजों की तुलना करता है ताकि पता चले कि कौन सा SBI ग्रुप स्टॉक सबसे अच्छा प्रदर्शन करता है।

items.title: SBI vs SBI Life vs SBI Cards: Which SBI Group stock emerged as the Q2 results 2026 winner? Check technical targets
items.text: SBI reported 14.28% annual profit growth in Q2 FY27, while SBI Cards’ profit jumped 75% and SBI Life’s rose 11%. Analysts said SBI Cards beat estimates, SBI was broadly in line and SBI Life missed expectations, with some preferring SBI for its outlook.
items.summary: SBI reported 14.28% annual profit growth in Q2 FY27, SBI Cards' profit jumped 75%, and SBI Life's rose 11%. Analysts said SBI Cards beat estimates, SBI was in line, and SBI Life missed expectations.
items.title_hi: SBI बनाम SBI Life बनाम SBI Cards: Q2 परिणाम 2026 में कौन सा SBI ग्रुप स्टॉक विजेता रहा? तकनीकी लक्ष्य देखें
items.summary_hi: SBI ने Q2 FY27 में 14.28% वार्षिक लाभ वृद्धि दर्ज की, जबकि SBI Cards का लाभ 75% बढ़ा और SBI Life का 11% बढ़ा। विश्लेषकों ने कहा कि SBI Cards अनुमानों से बेहतर रहा, SBI मोटे तौर पर अनुमान के अनुरूप रहा और SBI Life उम्मीदों से चूक गया।

items.title: US optimism fuels Nifty’s strongest 5-day rally in seven months
items.text: Benchmark closes above 200-DMA for first time since August; broader markets outperform amid strong FII inflows
items.summary: The Nifty index had its strongest five-day rally in seven months, closing above the 200-day moving average for the first time since August. Foreign institutional investors bought heavily.
items.title_hi: अमेरिकी आशावाद से निफ्टी की सात महीने में सबसे मजबूत 5-दिन की तेजी
items.summary_hi: निफ्टी ने सात महीने में सबसे मजबूत पांच दिन की रैली दर्ज की और अगस्त के बाद पहली बार 200-डीएमए के ऊपर बंद हुआ। विदेशी संस्थागत निवेशकों ने जमकर खरीदारी की।

items.title: Borderless investors report unauthorised trades in their accounts
items.text: Investors allege their US large-cap holdings were sold and proceeds diverted into thinly traded microcap stocks; FIRs and Sebi complaints have been filed
items.summary: Investors claim their US large-cap holdings were sold without authorization and proceeds moved into thinly traded microcap stocks. They have filed FIRs and Sebi complaints.
items.title_hi: बॉर्डरलेस निवेशकों ने अपने खातों में अनधिकृत ट्रेड की शिकायत की
items.summary_hi: निवेशकों का आरोप है कि उनके अमेरिकी लार्ज-कैप होल्डिंग्स को बिना अनुमति बेचा गया और आय को कम कारोबार वाले माइक्रोकैप स्टॉक्स में डाला गया। उन्होंने FIR और सेबी में शिकायत दर्ज कराई है।

items.title: Trade body sees India’s 2026-27 cotton output shrink 14% on dip in area, drought
items.text: Consumption seen flat at 365 lakh bales, while exports and imports are projected to decline over last year
items.summary: A trade body expects India's cotton output to fall 14% in 2026-27 due to a drop in cultivated area and drought. Consumption is seen flat at 365 lakh bales. Exports and imports are projected to decline compared to last year.
items.title_hi: व्यापार निकाय को 2026-27 में भारत का कपास उत्पादन 14% घटने का अनुमान
items.summary_hi: एक व्यापार निकाय को उम्मीद है कि 2026-27 में भारत का कपास उत्पादन क्षेत्रफल में कमी और सूखे के कारण 14% गिर जाएगा। खपत 365 लाख गांठ पर स्थिर रहने का अनुमान है। निर्यात और आयात में पिछले साल की तुलना में गिरावट का अनुमान है।

items.title: SEBI forms working group to review Innovators Growth Platform framework
items.text: The working group will review listing eligibility, investor participation, pricing and disclosure norms to improve capital market access for deep-tech and other innovation-led firms
items.summary: SEBI has formed a working group to review the Innovators Growth Platform framework. The group will examine listing eligibility, investor participation, pricing, and disclosure norms to improve capital market access for deep-tech and innovation-led firms.
items.title_hi: SEBI ने इनोवेटर्स ग्रोथ प्लेटफॉर्म फ्रेमवर्क की समीक्षा के लिए कार्य समूह बनाया
items.summary_hi: SEBI ने इनोवेटर्स ग्रोथ प्लेटफॉर्म फ्रेमवर्क की समीक्षा के लिए एक कार्य समूह बनाया है। समूह लिस्टिंग पात्रता, निवेशक भागीदारी, मूल्य निर्धारण और प्रकटीकरण मानदंडों की जांच करेगा ताकि डीप-टेक और अन्य इनोवेशन-आधारित फर्मों के लिए पूंजी बाजार पहुंच में सुधार हो सके।

items.title: Wall Street cheers US midterm results as Dow Jones jumps 1300 points; Amazon, Apple, Microsoft among top gainers
items.text: US stocks surged after Democratic midterm gains raised hopes of political gridlock, while falling oil prices and Treasury yields supported sentiment. The S&P 500 rose 1.8%, with major technology stocks leading gains.
items.summary: US stocks surged after Democratic midterm gains. The Dow Jones jumped 1300 points and S&P 500 rose 1.8%, led by major tech stocks like Amazon, Apple, and Microsoft.
items.title_hi: Wall Street ने US मध्यावधि परिणामों का स्वागत किया: Dow Jones 1300 अंक उछला; Amazon, Apple, Microsoft शीर्ष लाभ में
items.summary_hi: डेमोक्रेटिक मध्यावधि लाभ के बाद US शेयरों में उछाल आया। Dow Jones 1300 अंक चढ़ा और S&P 500 1.8% बढ़ा, प्रमुख तकनीकी शेयरों के नेतृत्व में।

items.title: Q2 Results Today Highlights: BSE, Apollo Hospitals, Sundaram Finance post higher profit in Q2; Biocon, Zydus Life profit declines
items.text: Q2 Results Today, 04th November 2026 Updates: businessline brings you the latest quarterly earnings, outlook and more.
items.summary: BSE, Apollo Hospitals, and Sundaram Finance posted higher profits in Q2. Biocon and Zydus Life saw profit declines.
items.title_hi: Q2 परिणाम आज: BSE, Apollo Hospitals, Sundaram Finance का मुनाफा बढ़ा; Biocon, Zydus Life का मुनाफा गिरा
items.summary_hi: BSE, Apollo Hospitals और Sundaram Finance ने Q2 में अधिक मुनाफा दर्ज किया। Biocon और Zydus Life का मुनाफा घटा।

items.title: One Factor I Consider For Elevation Is How Judge Would Be A Team Player In Supreme Court : CJI Surya Kant
items.text: With so much filings, Supreme Court is virtually playing a T20 match, CJI said, at the SCBA felicitation for the newly elevated judges.
items.summary: CJI Surya Kant said one factor for judicial elevation is how a judge would work as a team player in the Supreme Court. He compared the court's heavy caseload to a T20 cricket match during a felicitation for newly elevated judges.
items.title_hi: ऊंचाई के लिए मैं जिस एक कारक पर विचार करता हूं वह है कि जज सुप्रीम कोर्ट में टीम प्लेयर कैसे होंगे: CJI सूर्य कांत
items.summary_hi: CJI सूर्य कांत ने कहा कि न्यायिक ऊंचाई के लिए एक कारक यह है कि जज सुप्रीम कोर्ट में टीम प्लेयर के रूप में कैसे काम करेंगे। उन्होंने नए ऊंचे किए गए जजों के अभिनंदन समारोह में कोर्ट के भारी केसलोड की तुलना T20 क्रिकेट मैच से की।

items.title: AI data center stocks dip, renewables surge after Democrat sweep in US midterm elections
items.text: AI data centre stocks declined while renewable energy and healthcare shares rallied after Democrats won control of Congress in the US midterm elections. Investors assessed the possibility of tighter AI oversight and continued clean energy support. Defence contractors and prison operators fell amid concerns over changing government spending and immigration policies.
items.summary: AI data center stocks fell while renewable energy and healthcare shares rose after Democrats won control of Congress in US midterm elections. Investors expect tighter AI oversight and continued clean energy support. Defence contractors and prison operators declined due to spending and immigration policy concerns.
items.title_hi: अमेरिकी मध्यावधि चुनाव में डेमोक्रेटिक जीत के बाद AI डेटा सेंटर स्टॉक्स गिरे, रिन्यूएबल्स में उछाल
items.summary_hi: अमेरिकी मध्यावधि चुनाव में डेमोक्रेट्स के कांग्रेस पर नियंत्रण के बाद AI डेटा सेंटर स्टॉक्स गिरे जबकि रिन्यूएबल एनर्जी और हेल्थकेयर शेयरों में तेजी आई। निवेशकों को सख्त AI निगरानी और स्वच्छ ऊर्जा समर्थन जारी रहने की उम्मीद है। रक्षा ठेकेदार और जेल ऑपरेटर्स खर्च और आव्रजन नीति चिंताओं से गिरे।

items.title: Government prepares draft sustainable aviation fuels policy; moots mandatory blending in ATF from 2027
items.text: The civil aviation ministry has circulated the draft National Policy on Sustainable Aviation Fuels which mandates use of only indigenously manufactured SAF to be blended with Aviation Turbine Fuel (ATF).
items.summary: The civil aviation ministry has circulated a draft National Policy on Sustainable Aviation Fuels. The policy proposes mandatory blending of indigenously manufactured sustainable aviation fuel with ATF from 2027. Only domestically produced SAF would be allowed for blending.
items.title_hi: सरकार ने टिकाऊ विमानन ईंधन नीति का मसौदा तैयार किया; 2027 से एटीएफ में अनिवार्य मिश्रण का प्रस्ताव
items.summary_hi: नागरिक विमानन मंत्रालय ने टिकाऊ विमानन ईंधन पर राष्ट्रीय नीति का मसौदा जारी किया। नीति में 2027 से केवल स्वदेशी निर्मित एसएएफ को एटीएफ में मिलाने का प्रस्ताव है। मिश्रण के लिए केवल घरेलू स्तर पर उत्पादित एसएएफ की अनुमति होगी।

items.title: Supreme Court 7-Judge Bench Holds Reference On States' Power For Additional Levy On Sales Tax Academic After GST
items.text: The Court held that the reference has been rendered infructuous.
items.summary: A seven-judge Supreme Court bench ruled that the reference on states' power to impose additional levy on sales tax after GST has become academic. The court held the reference is now infructuous.
items.title_hi: सुप्रीम कोर्ट की 7-जज बेंच ने GST के बाद बिक्री कर पर अतिरिक्त लेवी के लिए राज्यों की शक्ति पर संदर्भ को अकादमिक माना
items.summary_hi: सुप्रीम कोर्ट की सात-जज बेंच ने फैसला दिया कि GST के बाद बिक्री कर पर अतिरिक्त लेवी लगाने की राज्यों की शक्ति पर संदर्भ अकादमिक हो गया है। कोर्ट ने माना कि संदर्भ अब निरर्थक है।

items.title: Beyond HAL, BEL: Apollo Micro Systems, MTAR, Data Patterns, Zen Tech, among 5 defence stocks on experts' radar | List
items.text: India’s defence localisation push is drawing attention to private-sector companies alongside established public-sector firms. Analysts highlight MTAR Technologies, Zen Technologies, Astra Microwave, Data Patterns and Apollo Micro Systems
items.summary: Analysts are highlighting several private defence companies including Apollo Micro Systems, MTAR Technologies, Zen Technologies, Astra Microwave, and Data Patterns alongside public sector firms. India's defence localisation push is drawing attention to these private sector companies.
items.title_hi: HAL, BEL के अलावा: Apollo Micro Systems, MTAR, Data Patterns, Zen Tech समेत 5 डिफेंस स्टॉक्स विशेषज्ञों की नजर में
items.summary_hi: विशेषज्ञ Apollo Micro Systems, MTAR Technologies, Zen Technologies, Astra Microwave और Data Patterns जैसी निजी डिफेंस कंपनियों को सार्वजनिक क्षेत्र की फर्मों के साथ हाइलाइट कर रहे हैं। भारत के डिफेंस स्थानीयकरण प्रयास इन निजी क्षेत्र की कंपनियों की ओर ध्यान खींच रहे हैं।

items.title: Chalet Hotels Q2 net profit rises 40% to ₹216 crore, revenue falls 32%
items.text: Chalet Hotels reported a 39.6 per cent rise in Q2FY27 net profit to ₹216.3 crore, while revenue fell 31.7 per cent amid a sharp decline in real estate segment income.
items.summary: Chalet Hotels Q2 net profit rose about 40% to ₹216 crore, but revenue fell about 32% due to a sharp decline in real estate income.
items.title_hi: Chalet Hotels Q2 शुद्ध लाभ 40% बढ़कर ₹216 करोड़, आय 32% गिरी
items.summary_hi: Chalet Hotels का Q2 शुद्ध लाभ लगभग 40% बढ़कर ₹216 करोड़ हुआ, लेकिन रियल एस्टेट आय में तेज गिरावट से आय 32% घटी।

items.title: Premier Energies Q2 results: Net profit rises 30% to ₹458 crore as revenue jumps 43%
items.summary: Premier Energies Q2 net profit rose 30% to ₹458 crore, and revenue jumped 43%.

items.title: Triveni reassessing sugarcane outlook in Uttar Pradesh after unseasonal heavy rain
items.text: The company’s sugar inventory as on September 30, 2026 was 1.03 lakhs tonnes (lt), which is valued at ₹38.6/kg, as compared with 1.69 lt valued at ₹37.4/kg year-ago
items.summary: Triveni is reassessing its sugarcane outlook in Uttar Pradesh after unseasonal heavy rain. The company's sugar inventory on September 30, 2026 was 1.03 lakh tonnes valued at ₹38.6 per kg, compared to 1.69 lakh tonnes at ₹37.4 per kg a year earlier.
items.title_hi: बेमौसम भारी बारिश के बाद त्रिवेणी उत्तर प्रदेश में गन्ना परिदृश्य का पुनर्मूल्यांकन कर रही
items.summary_hi: बेमौसम भारी बारिश के बाद त्रिवेणी उत्तर प्रदेश में अपने गन्ना दृष्टिकोण का पुनर्मूल्यांकन कर रही है। कंपनी का चीनी भंडार 30 सितंबर 2026 को 1.03 लाख टन था, जिसका मूल्य ₹38.6 प्रति किलो था, जबकि एक साल पहले 1.69 लाख टन ₹37.4 प्रति किलो पर था।

items.title: Rythu Bharosa SMS to 2.73 lakh farmers sparks call for cybercrime probe
items.text: Stating that the messages, received by farmers in some districts, were ‘unauthorised’, Director of Agriculture B Gopi has asked the Cyber Crime Wing of the Telangana Police to investigate the matter
items.summary: Unauthorized SMS messages about Rythu Bharosa were sent to 2.73 lakh farmers in some districts. The Director of Agriculture has asked the Telangana Police's Cyber Crime Wing to investigate. The messages were described as unauthorized.
items.title_hi: रायथु भरोसा एसएमएस 2.73 लाख किसानों को भेजा गया, साइबर अपराध जांच की मांग
items.summary_hi: कुछ जिलों में 2.73 लाख किसानों को रायथु भरोसा के अनधिकृत एसएमएस भेजे गए। कृषि निदेशक ने तेलंगाना पुलिस के साइबर अपराध विंग से जांच करने को कहा है। संदेशों को अनधिकृत बताया गया है।

items.title: SEBI relaxes KYC rules for NRIs, OCIs: Can overseas investors now onboard digitally from abroad? Decoded
items.text: SEBI has eased KYC rules for NRIs, OCIs and foreign nationals, allowing eligible investors living in FATF-compliant countries to complete onboarding remotely.
items.summary: SEBI has relaxed KYC rules for NRIs, OCIs, and foreign nationals. Eligible investors in FATF-compliant countries can now complete onboarding remotely.
items.title_hi: SEBI ने NRIs, OCIs के लिए KYC नियमों में ढील दी: क्या विदेशी निवेशक अब विदेश से डिजिटल ऑनबोर्डिंग कर सकते हैं? समझाया गया
items.summary_hi: SEBI ने NRIs, OCIs और विदेशी नागरिकों के लिए KYC नियम आसान किए हैं। FATF-अनुपालक देशों में रहने वाले योग्य निवेशक अब दूर से ऑनबोर्डिंग पूरी कर सकते हैं।

items.title: LTCG tax relief on cards? FM acknowledges FPI concerns as SEBI, FICCI push for reforms in Budget 2027
items.text: FM Nirmala Sitharaman said the government recognizes investor concerns about India’s investment climate and will consider feedback as it seeks to sustain growth near 7%. She acknowledged rising foreign investment outflows.
items.summary: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman acknowledged foreign portfolio investor concerns about India's investment climate. She said the government will consider feedback as it aims to sustain growth near 7%. SEBI and FICCI are pushing for reforms in Budget 2027, including possible long-term capital gains tax relief.
items.title_hi: LTCG कर राहत के आसार? FM ने FPI चिंताओं को माना, SEBI और FICCI बजट 2027 में सुधारों की मांग कर रहे
items.summary_hi: वित्त मंत्री निर्मला सीतारमण ने भारत के निवेश माहौल पर विदेशी पोर्टफोलियो निवेशकों की चिंताओं को स्वीकार किया। उन्होंने कहा कि सरकार 7% के आसपास वृद्धि बनाए रखने के लिए फीडबैक पर विचार करेगी। SEBI और FICCI बजट 2027 में सुधारों की मांग कर रहे हैं, जिसमें दीर्घकालिक पूंजीगत लाभ कर राहत शामिल हो सकती है।

items.title: US Treasury shifts language, opening door to auction size changes
items.text: The US Treasury Department has updated its regulations regarding upcoming auction sizes for treasury securities. This revision hints at a potential increase in the issuance of short- and intermediate-term debt. They also flagged a likely decrease in demand for longer-term 20- and 30-year auctions. Future adjustments will rely on demand trends and financial requirements, with the Treasury planning to consult market participants for a thorough understanding of these changing factors.
items.summary: The US Treasury updated regulations on auction sizes for treasury securities. This may increase short- and intermediate-term debt issuance and decrease demand for longer-term 20- and 30-year auctions.
items.title_hi: US Treasury ने भाषा बदली, नीलामी आकार में बदलाव का रास्ता खोला
items.summary_hi: US Treasury विभाग ने ट्रेजरी सिक्योरिटीज की आगामी नीलामी आकार के नियमों को अपडेट किया। इससे छोटी और मध्यम अवधि के ऋण जारी करने में वृद्धि हो सकती है और 20-30 वर्ष की लंबी अवधि की नीलामियों की मांग घट सकती है।

items.title: Meta draws record orders for debut euro bond sale, Bloomberg News reports
items.text: Meta Platforms has successfully garnered an impressive €53 billion in investor interest for its inaugural euro bond issuance. With an ambition to raise €9 billion divided into six distinct parts, this move follows their recent $15 billion bond offering in the US market. Citigroup and Morgan Stanley are at the helm of this euro bond sale, with pricing anticipated shortly. As of September 30, Meta's total debt reached $83.67 billion.
items.summary: Meta Platforms received €53 billion in investor interest for its first euro bond sale. The company aims to raise €9 billion in six parts, following a recent $15 billion US bond offering. Citigroup and Morgan Stanley are managing the sale. As of September 30, Meta's total debt reached $83.67 billion.
items.title_hi: Meta की पहली यूरो बॉन्ड बिक्री के लिए रिकॉर्ड €53 बिलियन ऑर्डर मिले, Bloomberg की रिपोर्ट
items.summary_hi: Meta Platforms को अपनी पहली यूरो बॉन्ड बिक्री के लिए €53 बिलियन का निवेशक ब्याज मिला। कंपनी छह हिस्सों में €9 बिलियन जुटाना चाहती है, जो हाल के $15 बिलियन के अमेरिकी बॉन्ड ऑफरिंग के बाद है। Citigroup और Morgan Stanley बिक्री का प्रबंधन कर रहे हैं। 30 सितंबर तक Meta का कुल कर्ज $83.67 बिलियन पहुंच गया।

items.title: Clean energy sector receives long-term investment pledges of $400 billion
items.text: Union Minister Pralhad Joshi said the government had secured $400 billion in long-term investment commitments and was targeting another ₹21 lakh crore in renewable energy investment by 2030
items.summary: The government secured $400 billion in long-term investment commitments for clean energy. It is targeting another ₹21 lakh crore in renewable energy investment by 2030.
items.title_hi: स्वच्छ ऊर्जा क्षेत्र को 400 अरब डॉलर के दीर्घकालिक निवेश वादे मिले
items.summary_hi: केंद्रीय मंत्री प्रह्लाद जोशी ने कहा कि सरकार को 400 अरब डॉलर के दीर्घकालिक निवेश वादे मिले हैं और 2030 तक नवीकरणीय ऊर्जा में 21 लाख करोड़ रुपये के और निवेश का लक्ष्य है।

items.title: Gold gains 3% as dollar slides after Democratic midterm gains
items.text: On Wednesday, gold prices surged by 3%, reaching impressive new levels following the midterm elections, during which Democrats secured control of both the Senate and House. This political transformation, combined with a weaker dollar, heightened gold and precious metals demand. Investors are keenly watching for the upcoming US non-farm payrolls report, as rising interest rates and ongoing fiscal risk concerns continue to influence market sentiment.
items.summary: Gold prices rose 3% after Democrats won control of both the Senate and House in the US midterm elections. A weaker dollar increased demand for gold and precious metals.
items.title_hi: डॉलर गिरने और डेमोक्रेटिक मध्यावधि लाभ के बाद सोना 3% चढ़ा
items.summary_hi: अमेरिकी मध्यावधि चुनाव में डेमोक्रेट्स के सीनेट और हाउस दोनों पर नियंत्रण पाने के बाद सोने की कीमतें 3% बढ़ीं। कमजोर डॉलर ने सोने और कीमती धातुओं की मांग बढ़ा दी।

items.title: Prediction markets get Democratic win right, with a few surprises
items.text: Prediction markets provided insights during the US midterm elections, with $1.48 billion wagered on the outcomes. Democrats gained control of both the Senate and House of Representatives after delivering a rebuke to Donald Trump. Despite some accurate forecasts, notable surprises emerged, such as Annie Andrews' victory in South Carolina against expectations. Kalshi and Polymarket reflected varying probabilities, emphasizing the predictive capabilities of betting markets.
items.summary: Prediction markets saw $1.48 billion wagered on US midterm elections and correctly forecast Democrats winning both Senate and House. Some surprises occurred, like Annie Andrews' victory in South Carolina.
items.title_hi: भविष्यवाणी बाजारों ने डेमोक्रेटिक जीत का सही अनुमान लगाया, कुछ आश्चर्य के साथ
items.summary_hi: अमेरिकी मध्यावधि चुनावों पर $1.48 बिलियन का दांव लगा और भविष्यवाणी बाजारों ने डेमोक्रेट्स के सीनेट और हाउस दोनों जीतने का सही अनुमान लगाया। कुछ आश्चर्य भी हुए, जैसे दक्षिण कैरोलिना में Annie Andrews की जीत।

items.title: Govt clears ₹4K cr VISTAR scheme to revamp India's statistical system
items.text: The five-year VISTAR scheme will fund 59 surveys, the 8th Economic Census and AI-driven statistical reforms, while strengthening state-level data systems and GDP estimates.
items.summary: The government has approved a ₹4,000 crore VISTAR scheme to overhaul India's statistical system. The five-year plan will fund 59 surveys, the 8th Economic Census, and AI-driven statistical reforms. It also aims to strengthen state-level data systems and GDP estimates.
items.title_hi: सरकार ने भारत की सांख्यिकीय प्रणाली को सुधारने के लिए ₹4K करोड़ की VISTAR योजना मंजूर की
items.summary_hi: सरकार ने भारत की सांख्यिकीय प्रणाली को दुरुस्त करने के लिए ₹4,000 करोड़ की VISTAR योजना को मंजूरी दी है। पांच साल की योजना में 59 सर्वेक्षण, 8वीं आर्थिक जनगणना और AI-संचालित सांख्यिकीय सुधारों को वित्त पोषित किया जाएगा। इसका उद्देश्य राज्य-स्तरीय डेटा प्रणालियों और GDP अनुमानों को मजबूत करना भी है।

items.text: The Indian rupee appreciated for the second consecutive session, closing 17 paise higher against the US dollar. The dollar index experienced a decline, reflecting a weaker American currency. These factors indicated improved global sentiment following the US midterm elections.

items.title: Political Islam, the Italian left and the battle for Italy's streets
items.text: Youssef Siher's recent legal troubles have raised concerns about political Islam's influence in Italy. Pro-Palestinian movements have garnered the attention of various political parties ahead of elections. Conflicts surrounding proposed mosques in Turin and Mestre illustrate growing tensions in local politics. There is an emerging alliance between the left and Muslim community activists over shared objectives. It remains to be seen how these dynamics will affect the upcoming 2027 elections.

items.title: Congress, allies creating anarchy: Adityanath
items.text: Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath has accused Congress and its allies of fostering anarchy and threatening democracy. He criticized the opposition for blaming electronic voting machines when they lose elections, despite celebrating their wins. Adityanath also addressed the importance of the Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls while condemning foreign infiltrators' inclusion. Additionally, he called for an apology from Congress regarding its historical actions during the Emergency.
items.summary: Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath accused Congress and its allies of creating anarchy and threatening democracy. He criticized the opposition for blaming electronic voting machines when they lose elections. He also called for an apology from Congress regarding its historical actions during the Emergency.

items.title: Services sector growth hits a four-month peak in October, PMI survey shows
items.text: Driven by strong domestic demand, HSBC's India Services PMI rose to 55.8 in October as cost pressures eased to a six-year low, even as export orders and hiring slowed.
items.summary: India's services sector growth reached a four-month high in October according to the HSBC PMI survey. The PMI rose to 55.8 driven by strong domestic demand, while cost pressures eased to a six-year low despite slower export orders and hiring.

items.title: Rupee likely to resume slide as foreign outflows keep pressure on currency
items.text: The median forecast of 37 strategists polled between November 2 ​and 4 was for the rupee, currently trading near 94.70 per dollar, to weaken to 96.00 by end-January ‌and 96.33 by end-April

items.title: Zydus Lifesciences Q2 results: Net profit falls 26.6% to ₹925.5 crore
items.text: Zydus Lifesciences on Wednesday posted a 26.6 per cent decline in consolidated net profit to Rs 925.5 crore in the September quarter weighed down by an increase in expenses. The company had posted a net profit of Rs 1,260.9 crore in the corresponding period of the previous fiscal year, it said in a regulatory filing to the exchanges. Revenue from operations rose to Rs 7,909.6 crore during the quarter under review from Rs 6,123.2 crore in the year-ago period, it said. Zydus' total expenses rose sharply to Rs 6,806.6 crore during the quarter from Rs 4,509 crore in the same period last year. Duri
items.summary: Zydus Lifesciences reported a 26.6% decline in net profit to ₹925.5 crore for Q2, while revenue rose to ₹7,909.6 crore from ₹6,123.2 crore a year earlier.

items.title: Trump's midterm setback may put India under pressure for quick trade deal on US terms: GTRI
items.text: Amid electoral challenges, US President Donald Trump is likely to ramp up pressure on India to seal a trade deal. This potential agreement would require India to decrease import tariffs on US goods while the US keeps its tariffs intact. Analysts caution that such an arrangement may breach WTO MFN principles, undermining India's trade credibility. Additionally, compromising energy security and development aspirations could have serious implications.
items.summary: Following midterm electoral challenges, President Trump may pressure India for a quick trade deal on US terms. The deal would require India to cut import tariffs on US goods while US tariffs remain unchanged, which analysts say could violate WTO MFN principles and harm India's trade credibility and energy security.

items.title: RBI sets up panel with banks, market players to review financial market issues
items.text: India's central bank has formed a technical consultative committee to engage with market participants on financial issues. This committee will include seven external members from various financial institutions and will address market infrastructure. items.title: Piyush Goyal holds talks with Danish minister to expand economic partnership
items.text: India and Denmark are actively exploring various opportunities to strengthen their economic engagement and partnerships. The discussions between Piyush Goyal and Martin Lidegaard emphasized collaborative efforts in trade, investment, and industrial cooperation. Approximately 250 Danish companies operate in India, employing over 100,000 individuals while showing strong interest in further investments. Cooperation in renewable energy and wind energy technologies has been a core focus of their partnership.

items.title: Geographical branding revolutionized French champagne; are GI tags working for India, too?
items.text: India has thousands of products unique to a particular area, and the last few years have seen greater impetus to assign them a Geographical Indication (GI) tag, or an geographical origin branding. So far, some stories have played out successfully, while other hold potential to be unlocked.
items.summary: India has thousands of area-specific products and has increased efforts to assign them Geographical Indication (GI) tags. Some GI-tagged products have succeeded, while others still hold untapped potential.

items.title: Gig workers may get social security benefits through 2% transaction levy on businesses
items.text: The government is considering implementing a 2% transaction-based levy on aggregators to support social security for gig workers. This levy will fund benefits such as insurance, health, and maternity support for over 12 million workers. There is a consensus that this approach ensures fairness among different types of aggregators. The new scheme is expected to be launched in 2027, requiring gig workers to meet specific work criteria.
items.summary: The government is considering a 2% transaction levy on aggregators to fund social security benefits for gig workers. The levy would cover insurance, health, and maternity support for over 12 million workers. The scheme is expected to launch in 2027 with specific work criteria for eligibility.

items.summary: India's imports of tree nuts and chocolates rose significantly during the festive season. This reflects a 10-12% annual demand increase. The reduction in goods and services tax made these gourmet products more accessible to consumers.
items.title_hi: त्योहारी मांग से इस सीजन में सूखे मेवे, चॉकलेट का आयात बढ़ा
items.summary_hi: त्योहारी सीजन के दौरान भारत का मेवे और चॉकलेट का आयात काफी बढ़ा है। यह 10-12% की वार्षिक मांग वृद्धि को दर्शाता है। वस्तु एवं सेवा कर में कमी ने इन गोरमेट उत्पादों को उपभोक्ताओं के लिए अधिक सुलभ बना दिया है।

items.title: SIR-excluded voters can reapply without fear of 'false declaration' charges: ECI clears air
items.text: The Election Commission of India recently clarified concerns regarding filling Form 6 for re-inclusion on electoral rolls. This clarification aims to alleviate fears among registered voters about potential legal consequences. The clarification follows a Delhi High Court order that deemed such apprehensions as misplaced.
items.summary: The Election Commission of India clarified that SIR-excluded voters can reapply using Form 6 without fear of false declaration charges. This follows a Delhi High Court order calling such fears misplaced.
items.title_hi: SIR-बहिष्कृत मतदाता 'झूठी घोषणा' आरोप के डर के बिना पुनः आवेदन कर सकते हैं: ECI ने स्पष्ट किया
items.summary_hi: भारत निर्वाचन आयोग ने स्पष्ट किया कि SIR-बहिष्कृत मतदाता फॉर्म 6 भरकर बिना झूठी घोषणा के आरोप के डर के पुनः आवेदन कर सकते हैं। यह दिल्ली उच्च न्यायालय के आदेश के बाद आया है जिसमें ऐसी आशंकाओं को गलत बताया गया था।

items.title: RBI eases forex rules for services exports and imports
items.text: The changes form part of the Foreign Exchange Management (Export and Import of Goods and Services) which came into effect from October 1, 2026. Under the amended regulations, a resident individual exporting services will be deemed to have submitted the Export Declaration Form, or EDF, once the individual provides the authorised dealer bank with the information required to credit the payment to the exporter's account. No transaction-value threshold has been prescribed for resident individuals.
items.summary: RBI has eased forex rules for services exports and imports effective October 1, 2026. Resident individuals exporting services will be deemed to have submitted the Export Declaration Form once they provide required information to the authorised dealer bank, with no transaction-value threshold prescribed.
items.title_hi: RBI ने सर्विसेज एक्सपोर्ट और इम्पोर्ट के लिए फॉरेक्स नियम आसान किए
items.summary_hi: RBI ने 1 अक्टूबर 2026 से प्रभावी सर्विसेज एक्सपोर्ट और इम्पोर्ट के लिए फॉरेक्स नियम आसान किए हैं। सर्विसेज एक्सपोर्ट करने वाले निवासी व्यक्तियों को EDF जमा हुआ माना जाएगा जब वे अधिकृत डीलर बैंक को जरूरी जानकारी देंगे, कोई ट्रांजैक्शन-वैल्यू थ्रेशहोल्ड नहीं रखा गया।

items.title: Public spending must deliver results: Om Birla
items.text: Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla highlighted the importance of public accounts committees in ensuring accountability for public expenditure. He stated that public money must be used responsibly and for its intended purposes. PAC chairman KC Venugopal expressed concerns over six state chief secretaries missing a crucial meeting.
items.summary: Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla stressed that public spending must be accountable and used for intended purposes. PAC chairman KC Venugopal raised concerns about six state chief secretaries missing an important meeting.
items.title_hi: लोकसभा अध्यक्ष ओम बिरला बोले - जनता का खर्च परिणाम देना चाहिए
items.summary_hi: लोकसभा अध्यक्ष ओम बिरला ने कहा कि सार्वजनिक खर्च जवाबदेह होना चाहिए और सही कामों में लगे। PAC अध्यक्ष केसी वेणुगोपाल ने छह राज्यों के मुख्य सचिवों के अहम बैठक में न आने पर चिंता जताई।

items.title: US Treasury yields climb as strong jobs data, midterm polls weigh; 10-year yield eyes 5% again
items.text: US Treasury yields climbed as stronger than expected September jobs data pointed to a resilient labour market, while investors awaited the midterm election results. Falling oil prices briefly eased pressure on bonds, but the move reversed as economic data reinforced growth expectations and uncertainty over future US fiscal policy kept investors cautious.
items.summary: US Treasury yields rose after strong jobs data showed a resilient labor market. Investors are also watching midterm election results and fiscal policy uncertainty. The 10-year yield is approaching 5% again.
items.title_hi: मजबूत नौकरी डेटा, मध्यावधि चुनाव के कारण अमेरिकी ट्रेजरी यील्ड बढ़ीं; 10-वर्षीय यील्ड फिर 5% की ओर
items.summary_hi: मजबूत नौकरी डेटा के बाद अमेरिकी ट्रेजरी यील्ड बढ़ीं, जिससे लचीला श्रम बाजार दिखा। निवेशक मध्यावधि चुनाव परिणाम और राजकोषीय नीति अनिश्चितता देख रहे हैं। 10-वर्षीय यील्ड फिर 5% के करीब पहुंच रही है।

items.title: Corn futures hit four-month low on big US crop, export worries
items.text: GLOBAL-GRAINS/ (UPDATE 3):GRAINS-Corn futures hit four-month low on big US crop, export worries
items.summary: Corn futures fell to a four-month low due to a large US crop and concerns about exports.
items.title_hi: अमेरिका की बड़ी फसल और निर्यात चिंताओं से कॉर्न फ्यूचर्स चार महीने के निचले स्तर पर
items.summary_hi: बड़ी अमेरिकी फसल और निर्यात की चिंताओं के कारण कॉर्न फ्यूचर्स चार महीने के निचले स्तर पर गिरे।

items.title: Taco Bell sales fall more than expected on cyclosporiasis outbreak hit
items.text: Yum Brands faced a setback in the third quarter as Taco Bell reported declining sales, primarily due to a cyclosporiasis outbreak that sparked customer concerns. While the outbreak severely impacted customer traffic, there was a notable recovery in sales during September and October. Although same-store sales remained flat, falling short of analysts' predictions, the company surpassed profit expectations, boosting investor trust in Yum Brands.
items.summary: Taco Bell sales dropped more than expected due to a cyclosporiasis outbreak. Sales recovered in September and October, but same-store sales stayed flat. Yum Brands still beat profit expectations, increasing investor confidence.
items.title_hi: साइक्लोस्पोरियासिस प्रकोप के कारण टैको बेल की बिक्री उम्मीद से अधिक गिरी
items.summary_hi: साइक्लोस्पोरियासिस प्रकोप के कारण टैको बेल की बिक्री उम्मीद से अधिक गिरी। सितंबर और अक्टूबर में बिक्री में सुधार हुआ, लेकिन सम-स्टोर बिक्री स्थिर रही। यम ब्रांड्स ने फिर भी लाभ अनुमानों को पार किया, जिससे निवेशक विश्वास बढ़ा।

items.title: Supreme Court Pauses Mumbai Civic Body Chief's Salary Over Encroachments
items.text: The three-judge bench also rejected the BMC's plea for an additional 30 days to complete the task. It said the civic body must comply with the court's earlier directions before seeking further relief.
items.summary: The Supreme Court has paused the Mumbai civic body chief's salary over encroachment issues. A three-judge bench rejected the BMC's request for 30 more days to comply with earlier court directions.
items.title_hi: सुप्रीम कोर्ट ने अतिक्रमण पर मुंबई नगर निकाय प्रमुख का वेतन रोका
items.summary_hi: सुप्रीम कोर्ट ने अतिक्रमण के मामले में मुंबई नगर निकाय प्रमुख का वेतन रोक दिया है। तीन जजों की बेंच ने BMC की 30 दिन की मोहलत की मांग खारिज कर दी और पहले के आदेश मानने को कहा।

items.title: Festive season: Pistachio prices nearly double, almonds up 20% on West Asia crisis and US crop shortfall
items.text: "Pistachio have been the game spoiler this year. The prices of pistachio from all origins including Iran, Afghanistan and California have increased," said Ravindra Mehta, member of central governing council at Nuts and Dry Fruits Council of India (NDFC-I). "The current pistachio crop in California is expected to be only about 40% of last year, which has led to an increase of 50% in pista prices in the wholesale markets and even more in retail," he added.
items.summary: Pistachio prices have nearly doubled and almonds are up 20% this festive season due to West Asia crisis and US crop shortfall. The current California pistachio crop is expected to be only about 40% of last year, leading to a 50% increase in wholesale pista prices and even more in retail.
items.title_hi: त्योहारी सीजन: पिस्ता की कीमत लगभग दोगुनी, बादाम 20% महंगे
items.summary_hi: वेस्ट एशिया संकट और US फसल कमी के कारण इस त्योहारी सीजन में पिस्ता की कीमत लगभग दोगुनी हो गई है और बादाम 20% महंगे हैं। कैलिफोर्निया की मौजूदा पिस्ता फसल पिछले साल का केवल 40% रहने की उम्मीद है, जिससे होलसेल में पिस्ता 50% महंगा और रिटेल में और ज्यादा।

items.title: Sugar Slides to Five-Week Low as High Indian Output Jolts Market
items.text: Sugar slid after data showed Indian production is running well ahead of last season, deepening a slump that has futures down more than 13% from last month’s peak.
items.summary: Sugar prices dropped to a five-week low after data showed Indian production running well ahead of last season. Futures are down more than 13% from last month's peak.
items.title_hi: भारतीय उत्पादन बढ़ने से चीनी पांच सप्ताह के निचले स्तर पर फिसली
items.summary_hi: चीनी की कीमतें पांच सप्ताह के निचले स्तर पर गिर गईं क्योंकि आंकड़ों से पता चला कि भारतीय उत्पादन पिछले सीजन से काफी आगे चल रहा है। फ्यूचर्स पिछले महीने के शिखर से 13% से अधिक नीचे हैं।

items.title: Rahul Gandhi Doubles Down On Debate Dare, Gets A Counter From N Sitharaman
items.text: JD(U) national spokesperson Rajeev Ranjan Prasad said Gandhi should raise all the issues he wants to discuss in Parliament if he has faith in parliamentary democracy.
items.summary: Rahul Gandhi has doubled down on his challenge for a debate. Nirmala Sitharaman has responded with a counter. JD(U) spokesperson Rajeev Ranjan Prasad said Gandhi should raise issues in Parliament if he believes in parliamentary democracy.
items.title_hi: राहुल गांधी ने बहस की चुनौती पर अड़े रहे, एन सीतारमण से जवाब मिला
items.summary_hi: राहुल गांधी ने बहस की अपनी चुनौती दोहराई है। निर्मला सीतारमण ने इसका जवाब दिया है। जेडी(यू) प्रवक्ता राजीव रंजन प्रसाद ने कहा कि अगर गांधी को संसदीय लोकतंत्र पर भरोसा है तो उन्हें संसद में मुद्दे उठाने चाहिए।

items.title: Rs 9,000 crore land assets monetised so far in FY27
items.text: The NLMC, which is working under the aegis of the Department of Public Enterprises under the finance ministry, also has land assets worth another Rs 4,000-5,000 crore belonging to public sector undertakings (PSUs) in the pipeline. These are at various stages of processing, providing an additional pipeline of potential transactions.
items.summary: NLMC has monetised Rs 9,000 crore of land assets so far in FY27, with another Rs 4,000-5,000 crore of PSU land assets in the pipeline.
items.title_hi: FY27 में 9,000 करोड़ की भूमि संपत्ति मुद्रीकृत
items.summary_hi: NLMC ने FY27 में 9,000 करोड़ रुपये की भूमि संपत्ति का मुद्रीकरण किया, और PSUs की 4,000-5,000 करोड़ रुपये की संपत्ति पाइपलाइन में है।

items.title: Polymarket unit gets US industry organization's approval to be futures broker
items.text: Polymarket has received approval from the National Futures Association for PM Derivatives LLC to act as a broker. This approval allows the company to expand its operations if it obtains further approval from the Commodity Futures Trading Commission. The firm is actively under investigation by the CFTC regarding its marketing practices. Currently, Polymarket serves as a popular platform for betting on various events and elections.
items.summary: Polymarket's unit PM Derivatives LLC received approval from the National Futures Association to act as a futures broker. The company still needs Commodity Futures Trading Commission approval to expand operations and is currently under CFTC investigation for marketing practices.
items.title_hi: पॉलीमार्केट की इकाई को अमेरिकी उद्योग संगठन की मंजूरी फ्यूचर्स ब्रोकर बनने के लिए
items.summary_hi: पॉलीमार्केट की इकाई PM डेरिवेटिव्स LLC को नेशनल फ्यूचर्स एसोसिएशन से फ्यूचर्स ब्रोकर के रूप में काम करने की मंजूरी मिली। कंपनी को कारोबार बढ़ाने के लिए कमोडिटी फ्यूचर्स ट्रेडिंग कमीशन की मंजूरी अभी चाहिए और यह CFTC की मार्केटिंग प्रथाओं की जांच का सामना कर रही है।

items.title: Centre targets 12% coastal freight share by 2047, says Minister Sonowal
items.text: Coastal Cargo Promotion Scheme and Cruise Bharat Mission expected to create over 5.6 lakh jobs and cut carbon emissions by 16 million tonnes; Puri to get ₹1,500 crore cruise terminal
items.summary: The Centre aims to achieve 12% coastal freight share by 2047. The Coastal Cargo Promotion Scheme and Cruise Bharat Mission are expected to create over 5.6 lakh jobs. These initiatives may cut carbon emissions by 16 million tonnes, and Puri will get a ₹1,500 crore cruise terminal.
items.title_hi: केंद्र का 2047 तक 12% तटीय माल ढुलाई हिस्सेदारी का लक्ष्य, मंत्री सोनोवाल ने कहा
items.summary_hi: केंद्र का लक्ष्य 2047 तक 12% तटीय माल ढुलाई हिस्सेदारी हासिल करना है। तटीय माल संवर्धन योजना और क्रूज भारत मिशन से 5.6 लाख से अधिक नौकरियां सृजित होने की उम्मीद है। इन पहलों से 16 मिलियन टन कार्बन उत्सर्जन कम हो सकता है, और पुरी को 1,500 करोड़ रुपये का क्रूज टर्मिनल मिलेगा।

items.title: Down 38% in 2026, Aditya Birla Real Estate gets Buy rating from Anand Rathi; 30% upside see
items.text: Anand Rathi initiated coverage of Aditya Birla Real Estate with a Buy rating and a ₹1,345 target, implying 30% upside. It expects pre-sales to recover from FY28, supported by a stronger launch pipeline, though the delayed Niyaara Tower C launch may weigh on FY27.
items.summary: Aditya Birla Real Estate, down 38% in 2026, received a Buy rating from Anand Rathi with a target of ₹1,345, implying 30% upside. Pre-sales are expected to recover from FY28 due to a stronger launch pipeline, but the delayed Niyaara Tower C launch may weigh on FY27.
items.title_hi: 2026 में 38% गिरावट के बाद, आदित्य बिड़ला रियल एस्टेट को आनंद राठी से खरीद रेटिंग; 30% उछाल की उम्मीद
items.summary_hi: आदित्य बिड़ला रियल एस्टेट, जो 2026 में 38% गिरा है, को आनंद राठी से ₹1,345 के लक्ष्य के साथ खरीद रेटिंग मिली है, जिसका अर्थ 30% उछाल है। प्री-सेल्स FY28 से मजबूत लॉन्च पाइपलाइन के कारण ठीक होने की उम्मीद है, हालांकि नियारा टावर C के लॉन्च में देरी FY27 पर असर डाल सकती है।

items.title: Supreme Court Daily Round-Up : November 3, 2026
items.summary: This is a daily round-up of Supreme Court proceedings for November 3, 2026.
items.title_hi: सुप्रीम कोर्ट दैनिक राउंड-अप: 3 नवंबर 2026
items.summary_hi: यह 3 नवंबर 2026 के लिए सुप्रीम कोर्ट की कार्यवाही का दैनिक राउंड-अप है।

items.title: Lloyds Metals Q2 results: Net profit jumps 88.1% to ₹1,046 crore, revenue rises 55.3% to ₹5,673 crore
items.summary: Lloyds Metals reported a sharp rise in net profit and revenue for the second quarter. Net profit jumped 88.1% to ₹1,046 crore while revenue increased 55.3% to ₹5,673 crore.
items.title_hi: लॉयड्स मेटल्स Q2 परिणाम: शुद्ध लाभ 88.1% बढ़कर ₹1,046 करोड़, राजस्व 55.3% बढ़कर ₹5,673 करोड़
items.summary_hi: लॉयड्स मेटल्स ने दूसरी तिमाही में शुद्ध लाभ और राजस्व में तेज वृद्धि दर्ज की। शुद्ध लाभ 88.1% बढ़कर ₹1,046 करोड़ हो गया, जबकि राजस्व 55.3% बढ़कर ₹5,673 करोड़ रहा।
items.key_numbers: Profit ₹1,046 cr (+88.1% YoY) · Revenue ₹5,673 cr (+55.3% YoY)

items.title: Aga Ruhullah quits National Conference, resigns as Srinagar MP over party's 'betrayal' of J&K promises
items.text: National Conference MP Aga Ruhullah Mehdi resigned from the party and Parliament on Tuesday, accusing it of betraying promises made to the people of Jammu and Kashmir, including on Article 370. The party hit back, calling his resignation an example of "moral and mental bankruptcy" and accusing him of empty rhetoric.
items.summary: National Conference MP Aga Ruhullah Mehdi has resigned from the party and Parliament. He accused the party of betraying promises to Jammu and Kashmir, including on Article 370. The party called his resignation "moral and mental bankruptcy" and empty rhetoric.
items.title_hi: आगा रुहुल्ला ने नेशनल कॉन्फ्रेंस छोड़ी, श्रीनगर सांसद पद से इस्तीफा दिया, पार्टी पर जम्मू-कश्मीर से वादाखिलाफी का आरोप
items.summary_hi: नेशनल कॉन्फ्रेंस के सांसद आगा रुहुल्ला मेहदी ने पार्टी और संसद से इस्तीफा दे दिया है। उन्होंने पार्टी पर जम्मू-कश्मीर के लोगों से किए वादे तोड़ने का आरोप लगाया, जिसमें अनुच्छेद 370 भी शामिल है। पार्टी ने उनके इस्तीफे को "नैतिक और मानसिक दिवालियापन" बताया और खोखली बयानबाजी का आरोप लगाया।

items.title: US midterms put Trump-era crypto boom and prediction markets at risk
items.text: The US midterm elections could threaten the crypto friendly regulatory environment created under President Donald Trump. A potential Democratic takeover of Congress may bring tighter oversight of digital assets and prediction markets, putting companies such as Coinbase, Strategy and Bullish under pressure as investors reassess the sector's regulatory outlook.
items.summary: US midterm elections could threaten the crypto-friendly regulatory environment from the Trump era. A Democratic takeover of Congress may lead to tighter oversight of digital assets and prediction markets. Companies like Coinbase, Strategy, and Bullish face pressure as investors reassess regulatory outlook.
items.title_hi: अमेरिकी मध्यावधि चुनाव ट्रंप-युग के क्रिप्टो उछाल और भविष्यवाणी बाजारों को खतरे में डालते हैं

items.title: Sitharaman hits back at Rahul Gandhi over debate challenge, says Parliament is the right forum
items.text: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman responded to Rahul Gandhi's challenge for a debate by emphasizing the role of Parliament. She criticized Gandhi for not raising issues in the House and instead making them on social media. Sitharaman highlighted the frequent walkouts of Congress during discussions, questioning Gandhi's commitment to a real debate. The Finance Minister also noted a recent mock Parliament event, calling it a mockery of genuine parliamentary procedures.

items.title: Saudi Aramco Q3 net profit rises 35% on higher oil prices, stake sale
items.text: Majority state-owned oil company Saudi Aramco on Tuesday reported a 35 per cent increase in third-quarter net profit as earnings were boosted by higher oil prices and the sale of its stake in a Malaysian refining and petrochemical company. Net profit rose to USD 36.3 billion from USD 26.9 billion in the year-earlier quarter. Adjusted net profit, which leaves out the sale of a stake in PRefChem to Malaysian state oil company Petronas, rose 9 per cent to USD 31.2 billion. The company also benefitted from high profit margins at its refineries turning crude into useable products such as diesel fue
items.summary: Saudi Aramco's third-quarter net profit rose 35% to USD 36.3 billion, driven by higher oil prices and a stake sale. Adjusted net profit, excluding the PRefChem stake sale, increased 9% to USD 31.2 billion.

items.title: MP Rajya Sabha bypoll: Hardeep Singh Puri set to win as nominations of 2 others rejected
items.text: Hardeep Singh Puri is positioned to win the Rajya Sabha by-election due to rejected nominations. Two independent candidates had their papers dismissed, including one supported by Congress. Objections were raised regarding Puri's nomination, claiming flaws in his affidavit. However, the Returning Officer found no violations of the Representation of the People Act. Consequently, Congress leaders plan to challenge the decision in court as they decry the matter.
items.summary: Hardeep Singh Puri is set to win the Madhya Pradesh Rajya Sabha bypoll after nominations of two other candidates were rejected. The Returning Officer found no violations in Puri's affidavit, but Congress plans to challenge the decision in court.

items.text: CleanMax has surpassed analyst estimates for the third consecutive quarter, driven by portfolio expansion and strong business performance. items.title: Bagmane REIT declares Rs 527cr distribution to unitholders for September quarter
items.text: Bagmane Prime Office REIT announced a distribution of Rs 527 crore to unitholders for the September quarter. The company leased 1.2 million square feet during this period, achieving a committed occupancy rate of 99 percent. Most of the leasing activity was directed towards Global Capability Centres in Bengaluru, which highlights their preference for quality assets. The average rent achieved was slightly above the prevailing market rates, reflecting strong demand.

He invited the Prime Minister to choose any venue and appoint a judge for the debate.

items.title: Utkarsh Small Finance Bank reports sixth consecutive quarterly loss
items.text: Utkarsh Small Finance Bank experienced a loss of Rs 70 crore in the second quarter, marking six consecutive quarters of decline. The lender’s operating profit was Rs 85 crore, but provisions of Rs 166 crore led to the net loss. Its gross non-performing asset ratio improved slightly, standing at 5.96% at the end of September. The bank's gross loan portfolio saw a year-on-year growth of 7.5%, reaching Rs 20,062 crore.
items.summary: Utkarsh Small Finance Bank posted a net loss of ₹70 crore in Q2, its sixth straight quarterly loss. Operating profit was ₹85 crore but provisions of ₹166 crore led to the loss. Gross loan portfolio grew 7.5% to ₹20,062 crore.
items.title_hi: Utkarsh Small Finance Bank: लगातार छठी तिमाही में घाटा, Q2 में ₹70 करोड़ का नुकसान
items.summary_hi: Utkarsh Small Finance Bank को Q2 में ₹70 करोड़ का शुद्ध घाटा हुआ, लगातार छठी तिमाही। परिचालन लाभ ₹85 करोड़ था लेकिन ₹166 करोड़ के प्रावधान से घाटा हुआ। सकल ऋण पोर्टफोलियो 7.5% बढ़कर ₹20,062 करोड़ हुआ।

items.title: Nexus Select Trust’s Q2 NOI rises 8% to Rs 504 cr, consumption up 13%
items.text: Nexus Select Trust reported an 8% year-on-year increase in net operating income for the second quarter. The company's retail assets experienced a 13% rise in consumption compared to the previous year. Nexus declared a distribution of Rs 359 crore, maintaining a 100% payout to unitholders for 13 consecutive quarters. The firm is expanding its portfolio with plans to develop a Grade-A mall and hotel in Guwahati.
items.summary: Nexus Select Trust reported 8% year-on-year increase in net operating income for Q2, with consumption up 13%. It declared a distribution of Rs 359 crore, maintaining 100% payout for 13 consecutive quarters, and plans to develop a Grade-A mall and hotel in Guwahati.

items.title: RBI launches 3 surveys to capture inflation expectations, consumer confidence ahead of December policy meeting
items.text: Reserve Bank of India has announced the November 2026 round of the Inflation Expectations Survey of Households. This survey aims to capture households' perceptions regarding price movements and inflation based on their consumption patterns. Additionally, the Urban Consumer Confidence Survey seeks to understand household sentiments on the economic situation and employment. The Rural Consumer Confidence Survey collects perceptions from rural areas on economic conditions, income, and spending.
items.summary: RBI has launched three surveys to capture inflation expectations and consumer confidence ahead of the December policy meeting. The surveys include the Inflation Expectations Survey of Households, Urban Consumer Confidence Survey, and Rural Consumer Confidence Survey.

items.title: AP CM Naidu directs officials to ensure crop insurance for cyclone-hit farmers

items.title_hi: आंध्र प्रदेश के मुख्यमंत्री नायडू ने चक्रवात प्रभावित किसानों के लिए फसल बीमा सुनिश्चित करने का निर्देश दिया

items.title: Revenue of 51 cos in ASK Private Wealth Hurun India Gazelle index jump 50% in one year
items.text: The net worth of these companies were ₹3.3 lakh crore, according to the 2026 ASK Private Wealth Hurun India Gazelle index

items.title_hi: ASK प्राइवेट वेल्थ हुरून इंडिया गज़ेल इंडेक्स में 51 कंपनियों का राजस्व एक साल में 50% बढ़ा

items.title: India to develop tunneling machines rather than yield to China’s curbs: Goyal

items.title_hi: भारत चीन की पाबंदियों के आगे झुकने के बजाय खुद सुरंग बनाने की मशीनें विकसित करेगा: गोयल

items.text: The Court suspected BMC officers of colluding with encroachers and collecting ‘hafta’ from them.

items.title: What will new Samvat bring for investors? Experts to discuss at BS webinar

items.text: The rupee appreciated for the third consecutive session, supported by foreign fund inflows into domestic equities, but a rebound in crude oil prices and geopolitical tensions capped gains
items.summary: The rupee rose for a third straight day, closing at 94.75 to the dollar. Gains were supported by foreign fund inflows into Indian equities, though higher crude oil prices and geopolitical tensions limited the advance.
items.title_hi: रुपया तीसरे दिन बढ़त बढ़ाता रहा, डॉलर के मुकाबले 94.75 पर बंद हुआ
items.summary_hi: रुपया लगातार तीसरे दिन बढ़ा और डॉलर के मुकाबले 94.75 पर बंद हुआ। विदेशी फंड के भारतीय इक्विटी में आने से सहारा मिला, लेकिन कच्चे तेल की ऊंची कीमतों और भू-राजनीतिक तनाव ने बढ़त को सीमित रखा।
