items.summary: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio defended including Russia in G20 meetings despite criticism from EU and allies. He said dialogue is the only way to end the Ukraine war.
items.title_hi: रुबियो ने सहयोगियों की आलोचना के बावजूद रूस की G20 उपस्थिति का बचाव किया
items.summary_hi: अमेरिकी विदेश मंत्री मार्को रुबियो ने EU और सहयोगियों की आलोचना के बावजूद रूस को G20 बैठकों में शामिल करने का बचाव किया। उन्होंने कहा कि यूक्रेन युद्ध खत्म करने का एकमात्र रास्ता संवाद है।

items.title: In his first visit, BJP’s Bihar in-charge Harish Dwivedi stresses on strengthening the party
items.text: Dwivedi gave guidance on strengthening the organisation through regular meetings and effective public outreach campaigns
items.summary: BJP's Bihar in-charge Harish Dwivedi, on his first visit, emphasized strengthening the party organization through regular meetings and effective public outreach campaigns.
items.title_hi: अपनी पहली यात्रा में BJP के बिहार प्रभारी हरीश द्विवेदी ने पार्टी को मजबूत करने पर जोर दिया
items.summary_hi: BJP के बिहार प्रभारी हरीश द्विवेदी ने अपनी पहली यात्रा में नियमित बैठकों और प्रभावी जनसंपर्क अभियानों के माध्यम से पार्टी संगठन को मजबूत करने पर जोर दिया।

items.title: Madras High Court Advocates Association challenges 1965 Union Cabinet decision to continue English as common language for Supreme Court and all High Courts
items.text: Says, the 1965 decision came to its notice only in 2025 pursuant to details obtained by a lawyer under the Right to Information Act, 2005
items.summary: The Madras High Court Advocates Association has challenged a 1965 Union Cabinet decision to continue English as the common language for the Supreme Court and all High Courts. The association learned of this decision only in 2025 through an RTI application.
items.title_hi: मद्रास उच्च न्यायालय अधिवक्ता संघ ने 1965 के केंद्रीय मंत्रिमंडल के फैसले को चुनौती दी जो सुप्रीम कोर्ट और सभी उच्च न्यायालयों के लिए अंग्रेजी को आम भाषा बनाए रखने का था
items.summary_hi: मद्रास उच्च न्यायालय अधिवक्ता संघ ने 1965 के केंद्रीय मंत्रिमंडल के फैसले को चुनौती दी है जो सुप्रीम कोर्ट और सभी उच्च न्यायालयों के लिए अंग्रेजी को आम भाषा बनाए रखता है। संघ को इस फैसले का पता 2025 में एक आरटीआई आवेदन के जरिए लगा।

items.title: Carlyle, KKR Get Ready to Snatch Up Bargain Loans
items.text: Carlyle Group Inc., KKR & Co. and Oaktree Capital Management are among the money managers hoping to pounce on US leveraged loans increasingly selling at bargain prices.
items.summary: Carlyle Group, KKR, and Oaktree Capital Management are preparing to buy US leveraged loans that are selling at bargain prices. These money managers see an opportunity in the current market.
items.title_hi: Carlyle, KKR सस्ते ऋण खरीदने की तैयारी में
items.summary_hi: Carlyle Group, KKR, और Oaktree Capital Management अमेरिकी लीवरेज्ड ऋण खरीदने की तैयारी कर रहे हैं जो सौदेबाजी की कीमतों पर बिक रहे हैं। ये मनी मैनेजर वर्तमान बाजार में अवसर देखते हैं।

items.title: Abhijeet Dipke meets Mamata Banerjee; says CJP not to join INDIA bloc rally but supports cause
items.text: Dipke said he had called on Banerjee to express gratitude for her support to the outfit's first protest at Jantar Mantar on the NEET paper leak issue and her backing when its leaders Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka were arrested by the Delhi Police.
items.summary: Abhijeet Dipke met Mamata Banerjee to thank her for supporting their first protest at Jantar Mantar on the NEET paper leak issue. He said the CJP will not join the INDIA bloc rally but supports the cause.
items.title_hi: अभिजीत दीपके ने ममता बनर्जी से मुलाकात की; कहा CJP INDIA ब्लॉक रैली में शामिल नहीं होगा लेकिन कारण का समर्थन करता है
items.summary_hi: अभिजीत दीपके ने ममता बनर्जी से मिलकर NEET पेपर लीक मुद्दे पर जंतर मंतर पर पहले विरोध के लिए उनके समर्थन का धन्यवाद किया। उन्होंने कहा CJP INDIA ब्लॉक रैली में शामिल नहीं होगा लेकिन कारण का समर्थन करता है।

items.summary: IBBI has amended regulations to strengthen insolvency resolution of stressed real estate projects.

items.summary_hi: IBBI ने तनावग्रस्त रियल एस्टेट परियोजनाओं के दिवाला समाधान को मजबूत करने के लिए नियमों में संशोधन किया है।

items.title: Why did investors dump technology stocks this week? AI spending concerns trigger Wall Street sell-off
items.text: Heavy investments in data centres, weakening free cash flows and disappointing earnings outlooks weigh on tech giants
items.summary: Investors sold technology stocks this week due to concerns about heavy AI spending. Heavy investments in data centres, weakening free cash flows, and disappointing earnings outlooks are weighing on tech giants.
items.title_hi: निवेशकों ने इस सप्ताह प्रौद्योगिकी शेयरों को क्यों बेचा? AI खर्च की चिंता ने वॉल स्ट्रीट में बिकवाली शुरू की
items.summary_hi: निवेशकों ने इस सप्ताह भारी AI खर्च की चिंताओं के कारण प्रौद्योगिकी शेयरों को बेचा। डेटा सेंटरों में भारी निवेश, कमजोर होती फ्री कैश फ्लो और निराशाजनक आय दृष्टिकोण तकनीकी दिग्गजों पर दबाव डाल रहे हैं।

items.title: CBDT tightens merger rules for charity trusts, imposes five-year curbs on changing objectives
items.text: The Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT) has made it mandatory for organisations merging with another registered non-profit to inform the I-T Department within a prescribed deadline, get their accounts audited and disclose the reasons for the merger. The new rules, notified on October 30, also prevent organisations with regular registration from merging with those holding provisional registration, and vice versa.
items.summary: CBDT has tightened merger rules for charity trusts. Organisations merging with another non-profit must now inform the tax department, get accounts audited, and disclose reasons. The new rules also bar regular and provisional registered trusts from merging with each other.
items.title_hi: CBDT ने चैरिटी ट्रस्टों के विलय नियम सख्त किए, उद्देश्य बदलने पर पांच साल की रोक लगाई
items.summary_hi: CBDT ने चैरिटी ट्रस्टों के विलय के नियम सख्त कर दिए हैं। किसी अन्य गैर-लाभकारी संगठन के साथ विलय करने पर अब कर विभाग को सूचना देनी होगी, खातों का ऑडिट कराना होगा और कारण बताने होंगे। नए नियम नियमित और अनंतिम पंजीकरण वाले ट्रस्टों को आपस में विलय करने से रोकते हैं।

items.title: Quad Foreign Ministers Reaffirm Committment To Free Indo-Pacific: Statement
items.text: At the Quad meeting in Atlanta, External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar met US Secretary of State Marco Rubio and Foreign Ministers from Japan and Australia, Toshimitsu Motegi and Penny Wong, respectively.
items.summary: Quad foreign ministers met in Atlanta and reaffirmed commitment to a free Indo-Pacific. External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar met US Secretary of State Marco Rubio and foreign ministers from Japan and Australia.
items.title_hi: क्वाड विदेश मंत्रियों ने मुक्त हिंद-प्रशांत के प्रति प्रतिबद्धता दोहराई: बयान
items.summary_hi: क्वाड विदेश मंत्री अटलांटा में मिले और मुक्त हिंद-प्रशांत के प्रति प्रतिबद्धता दोहराई। विदेश मंत्री S जयशंकर ने अमेरिकी विदेश मंत्री मार्को रुबियो और जापान व ऑस्ट्रेलिया के विदेश मंत्रियों से मुलाकात की।

items.title: Binance replaces 90% of stolen crypto after record $6.3 billion hack, pledges to cover remaining losses
items.text: Cryptocurrency prices declined on Friday as Binance, the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange, sought to reassure customers that their funds remained safe following the theft of more than $6 billion worth of digital assets.
items.summary: Binance has replaced 90% of the crypto stolen in a $6.3 billion hack and pledged to cover the rest. Cryptocurrency prices fell on Friday as the exchange reassured customers their funds were safe.
items.title_hi: बिनांस ने रिकॉर्ड $6.3 बिलियन हैक के बाद चोरी हुए क्रिप्टो का 90% बदला, बाकी नुकसान की भरपाई का वादा किया
items.summary_hi: बिनांस ने $6.3 बिलियन हैक में चोरी हुए क्रिप्टो का 90% बदल दिया है और बाकी की भरपाई का वादा किया है। शुक्रवार को क्रिप्टोकरेंसी की कीमतें गिरीं क्योंकि एक्सचेंज ने ग्राहकों को भरोसा दिलाया कि उनके फंड सुरक्षित हैं।

items.title: 'Protest, Then Do Some Shopping': Rahul Gandhi After Traders Object To November 1 Rally
items.text: Rahul Gandhi asks Ramlila Maidan rally crowd to shop at Delhi markets as traders say INDIA bloc help should defer November 1 rally.
items.summary: Rahul Gandhi urged the rally crowd at Ramlila Maidan to shop at Delhi markets after traders objected to the November 1 rally. Traders said the INDIA bloc's support should defer the rally.
items.title_hi: 'विरोध, फिर कुछ खरीदारी': राहुल गांधी ने व्यापारियों के 1 नवंबर की रैली पर आपत्ति के बाद कहा
items.summary_hi: राहुल गांधी ने रामलीला मैदान की रैली की भीड़ से दिल्ली के बाजारों में खरीदारी करने का आग्रह किया, क्योंकि व्यापारियों ने 1 नवंबर की रैली पर आपत्ति जताई थी। व्यापारियों ने कहा कि INDIA ब्लॉक का समर्थन रैली को टालना चाहिए।

items.title: At Quad Meet, S Jaishankar Highlights Importance Of "Maintaining Stability"
items.text: In a post on X after the Quad Foreign Ministers' Meeting in Atlanta, S Jaishankar outlined the priorities he raised with US Secretary of State Marco Rubio, Japanese Foreign Minister Toshimitsu Motegi and Australian Foreign Minister Penny Wong.
items.summary: At the Quad Foreign Ministers' Meeting in Atlanta, S Jaishankar emphasized the importance of maintaining stability and outlined priorities discussed with counterparts from the US, Japan, and Australia.
items.title_hi: क्वाड बैठक में, एस जयशंकर ने 'स्थिरता बनाए रखने' के महत्व पर जोर दिया
items.summary_hi: अटलांटा में क्वाड विदेश मंत्रियों की बैठक के बाद X पर एक पोस्ट में, एस जयशंकर ने उन प्राथमिकताओं को रेखांकित किया जो उन्होंने अमेरिकी विदेश मंत्री मार्को रुबियो, जापानी विदेश मंत्री तोशीमित्सु मोतेगी और ऑस्ट्रेलियाई विदेश मंत्री पेनी वोंग के साथ उठाईं।

items.title: Action On Ground Must Match Targets: Pollution Body On Punjab Stubble Burning
items.text: The CAQM team visited several villages in Punjab, where farmers flagged difficulties in using crop residue management machinery to prevent stubble burning.
items.summary: The CAQM team visited Punjab villages and heard from farmers about difficulties in using crop residue management machinery to prevent stubble burning. The pollution body emphasized that action on the ground must match targets.
items.title_hi: पंजाब में पराली जलाने पर प्रदूषण निकाय: जमीनी कार्रवाई लक्ष्यों से मेल खानी चाहिए
items.summary_hi: CAQM टीम ने पंजाब के कई गांवों का दौरा किया जहां किसानों ने पराली जलाने से रोकने के लिए फसल अवशेष प्रबंधन मशीनरी के उपयोग में कठिनाइयों के बारे में बताया। प्रदूषण निकाय ने जोर दिया कि जमीनी कार्रवाई लक्ष्यों से मेल खानी चाहिए।

items.title: Noodles 'Too Spicy', 3 Men Thrash Fast-Food Shop Staff In Bengaluru
items.text: The accused, allegedly under the influence of alcohol, picked a fight with the fast-food shop staff over the noodles being too spicy.
items.summary: Three men allegedly under the influence of alcohol attacked fast-food shop staff in Bengaluru. The dispute started because the accused found the noodles too spicy.
items.title_hi: नूडल्स 'बहुत तीखे', 3 लोगों ने बेंगलुरु में फास्ट-फूड दुकान के कर्मचारियों को पीटा
items.summary_hi: तीन लोग कथित तौर पर शराब के नशे में बेंगलुरु में एक फास्ट-फूड दुकान के कर्मचारियों पर हमला कर दिया। विवाद इस बात पर शुरू हुआ कि नूडल्स बहुत तीखे थे।

items.title: Wall Street week ahead: All eyes on US midterm elections, jobs data; earnings from Apple, AMD and Palantir also in focus
items.text: Investors to track congressional elections and October employment report for clues on Federal Reserve interest rate outlook
items.summary: Investors will watch US midterm elections, jobs data, and earnings from Apple, AMD, and Palantir for clues on Federal Reserve interest rate outlook.

items.summary_hi: निवेशक अमेरिकी मध्यावधि चुनाव, अक्टूबर रोजगार रिपोर्ट और ऐप्पल, AMD, पलान्टिर की कमाई पर नजर रखेंगे ताकि फेडरल रिजर्व की ब्याज दर के दृष्टिकोण का संकेत मिल सके।

items.title: Case Against School After Boy, 8, Assaults 6-Year-Old Girl In Haryana
items.text: Preliminary investigation has pointed to negligence on the part of the school management. Police said the investigation has also raised concerns regarding security arrangements and supervision of students inside the school.
items.summary: A case has been filed against a school in Haryana after an 8-year-old boy allegedly assaulted a 6-year-old girl. Preliminary investigation points to negligence by the school management and raises concerns about security and supervision of students.
items.title_hi: हरियाणा में 8 साल के लड़के द्वारा 6 साल की बच्ची पर हमले के बाद स्कूल के खिलाफ मामला
items.summary_hi: हरियाणा में एक स्कूल के खिलाफ मामला दर्ज किया गया है जब एक 8 साल के लड़के ने कथित तौर पर एक 6 साल की बच्ची पर हमला किया। प्रारंभिक जांच स्कूल प्रबंधन की लापरवाही की ओर इशारा करती है और छात्रों की सुरक्षा और निगरानी पर चिंता जताती है।

items.title: Neeraj Kumar's fight shifts from Anant to Lalan Singh
items.text: After the Bihar MLC elections, Neeraj Kumar has openly criticized Lalan Singh for lack of support. Neeraj Kumar, now victorious, met with party leaders to express gratitude for their assistance. He emphasized that he will not seek blessings from Lalan Singh in the future. Additionally, Kumar is advocating for leadership under Nishant Kumar, the son of Nitish Kumar. JD(U) working president Sanjay Jha has encouraged internal resolution of these issues.
items.summary: After Bihar MLC elections, Neeraj Kumar criticised Lalan Singh for lack of support. He met party leaders to thank them and said he will not seek blessings from Lalan Singh. Kumar is advocating for leadership under Nishant Kumar, son of Nitish Kumar. JD(U) working president Sanjay Jha encouraged internal resolution.
items.title_hi: नीरज कुमार की लड़ाई अनंत से ललन सिंह की ओर मुड़ी
items.summary_hi: बिहार MLC चुनाव के बाद नीरज कुमार ने ललन सिंह की आलोचना की। उन्होंने पार्टी नेताओं से मिलकर धन्यवाद दिया और कहा कि वे ललन सिंह का आशीर्वाद नहीं लेंगे। कुमार नीतीश कुमार के बेटे निशांत कुमार के नेतृत्व की वकालत कर रहे हैं। JD(U) के कार्यकारी अध्यक्ष संजय झा ने आंतरिक समाधान को प्रोत्साहित किया।

items.title: Karnataka govt's five promises come at a price
items.text: Karnataka's Congress government has approved an increase in Nandini milk prices, raising it from ₹46 to ₹54 per litre. The government claims this hike will enhance farmers' income and address financial pressures. However, the Opposition BJP argues that this will add to the cost of living for citizens. The government's five guarantees are estimated to cost ₹51,000 crore this year, creating further financial strain.
items.summary: Karnataka's Congress government has raised Nandini milk prices from ₹46 to ₹54 per litre, claiming it will boost farmers' income. The Opposition BJP says this will increase living costs. The government's five guarantees are estimated to cost ₹51,000 crore this year, adding financial strain.
items.title_hi: कर्नाटक सरकार के पांच वादों की कीमत चुकानी पड़ रही है
items.summary_hi: कर्नाटक की कांग्रेस सरकार ने नंदिनी दूध की कीमत ₹46 से ₹54 प्रति लीटर बढ़ा दी है, दावा है कि इससे किसानों की आय बढ़ेगी। विपक्षी भाजपा का कहना है कि इससे नागरिकों की लागत बढ़ेगी। सरकार की पांच गारंटियों की लागत इस साल ₹51,000 करोड़ अनुमानित है, जिससे वित्तीय दबाव बढ़ रहा है।

items.title: UP CEO's X handle apologises after controversial reply to AAP leader Sanjay Singh
items.text: The Uttar Pradesh Chief Electoral Officer's (CEO) office apologised after its official X handle posted a sarcastic response to AAP leader Sanjay Singh's allegation of caste bias over a voter's name being mistranslated. The exchange triggered criticism from Opposition leaders, prompting the office to promise more polite and formal communication.
items.summary: The Uttar Pradesh CEO's office apologized after its X handle gave a sarcastic reply to AAP leader Sanjay Singh's allegation of caste bias. The incident drew criticism from opposition leaders, leading to a promise of more polite communication.
items.title_hi: UP CEO के X हैंडल ने AAP नेता संजय सिंह को विवादित जवाब देने के बाद माफी मांगी

items.title: ED arrests senior Samajwadi Party leader Azam Khan minutes after release from Rampur Jail
items.text: Azam Khan, a senior leader of the Samajwadi Party, was arrested by the Enforcement Directorate shortly after his bail. His bail was granted by the Allahabad High Court in an alleged dual PAN card case. The Enforcement Directorate is investigating financial irregularities linked to the Maulana Mohammad Ali Jauhar Trust and Mohammad Ali Jauhar University. Khan's land and buildings were provisionally attached under anti-money laundering laws by the agency.
items.summary: The Enforcement Directorate arrested senior Samajwadi Party leader Azam Khan minutes after his release from Rampur jail on bail in a dual PAN card case. ED is investigating financial irregularities linked to trusts and university, and has provisionally attached his properties.
items.title_hi: ED ने रामपुर जेल से रिहाई के तुरंत बाद सपा के वरिष्ठ नेता आजम खान को गिरफ्तार किया
items.summary_hi: प्रवर्तन निदेशालय ने दोहरे PAN कार्ड मामले में जमानत पर रिहा होने के तुरंत बाद सपा के वरिष्ठ नेता आजम खान को गिरफ्तार किया। ED मौलाना मोहम्मद अली जौहर ट्रस्ट और विश्वविद्यालय से जुड़ी वित्तीय अनियमितताओं की जांच कर रहा है और उनकी संपत्तियों को अस्थायी रूप से कुर्क किया गया है।

items.title: INDIA bloc holds mock impeachment of CEC Gyanesh Kumar, Rahul Gandhi calls him 'first target'
items.text: Opposition INDIA bloc leaders and MPs held a symbolic public impeachment of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar, accusing him of facilitating alleged electoral irregularities and disenfranchising voters through the Special Intensive Revision (SIR). Presided over by former Lok Sabha Speaker Meira Kumar, the mock Parliament passed a resolution listing six charges against the CEC.
items.summary: The opposition INDIA bloc held a symbolic public impeachment of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. They accused him of facilitating electoral irregularities and disenfranchising voters through the Special Intensive Revision. Former Lok Sabha Speaker Meira Kumar presided over the mock Parliament which passed a resolution with six charges.

items.text: Kant also stressed the need to transform rural India into centres of economic activity, innovation and entrepreneurship rather than limiting it to welfare delivery.

items.summary: SEBI has barred EKI Energy Services' Managing Director Manish Dabkara from the securities market for 12 months. The regulator found premature revenue recognition of ₹197.04 crore and fictitious expenses of ₹26.34 crore in the company's financial statements.
items.title_hi: SEBI ने EKI एनर्जी सर्विसेज के MD मनीष डबकरा को 12 महीने के लिए प्रतिबंधित किया

items.title: Sebi bars EKI Energy, MD Dabkara, others from market; imposes penalty
items.text: Markets regulator Sebi has barred EKI Energy Services Ltd and its Managing Director Manish Kumar Dabkara from the securities market for two months and 12 months, respectively, for misrepresenting financial statements of the carbon credits trading firm and diverting funds. Also, the regulator has restrained the company's former Chief Financial Officer (CFO) Mohit Kumar Agarwal from the securities market for eight months, while whole-time directors Naveen Sharma and Sonali Sheikh have been prohibited for five months and one month, respectively. Besides, Sebi has imposed monetary penalties totall
items.summary: SEBI has barred EKI Energy Services Ltd and its Managing Director Manish Kumar Dabkara from the securities market for two months and 12 months respectively. The former CFO Mohit Kumar Agarwal has been restrained for eight months, while whole-time directors Naveen Sharma and Sonali Sheikh have been prohibited for five months and one month respectively. SEBI has also imposed monetary penalties.
items.title_hi: SEBI ने EKI एनर्जी, MD डबकरा और अन्य को बाजार से प्रतिबंधित किया; जुर्माना लगाया

items.summary: The Centre released an additional tax devolution instalment of over Rs 1.09 lakh crore to state governments. This is the second additional instalment this financial year, aimed at helping states accelerate capital spending and fund welfare expenditure ahead of the festive season.

The 57th GST Council meeting on October 8 approved a host of reforms in GST processes, primarily covering registration, returns, refund and adjudication. Officials said some of the changes approved by the Council that can be implemented through administrative processes will be brough
items.summary: GST process reforms approved by the 57th GST Council meeting will be rolled out from November 1. The reforms include simplified registration for small e-commerce sellers, unified documentation, faster refunds, and a Rs 10,000 threshold for issuing GST notices.

items.title: Muthoot Finance Q2 profit rises 27% to ₹2,977 crore, income up 37%
items.text: Muthoot Finance on Saturday reported a 27 per cent growth in standalone profit at Rs 2,977 crore in the September quarter. Total income rose to Rs 8,842 crore in the July-September quarter, from Rs 6,442 crore in the corresponding quarter a year ago, Muthoot Finance said in a regulatory filing. Interest income rose to Rs 8,730 crore in Q2 of FY27, from Rs 6,304 crore in Q2 of FY26. items.summary: Muthoot Finance's standalone profit rose 27% to ₹2,977 crore in the September quarter. Total income increased 37% to ₹8,842 crore. Interest income rose to ₹8,730 crore. For the first half, consolidated profit after tax grew 39% to ₹6,103 crore.
